40/// @file
41/// @brief The UI document interpreter: `Interpreter::mount` turns a loaded `Document` into reactive state and a view
42/// tree, mounts it through `Mounted` on any `IViewBackend`, and runs its queries, mutations, relations and
43/// commands. Model calls go through a `Dispatcher` (the bridge's model-free seams in an application, a
44/// scripted fake in a test); what only the application can do goes through an `InterpreterHost`; what
45/// screens share — the query cache, the principal's permissions, the formatting facts — is a `Session`.
46
47namespace morph::ui {

53/// @brief How one model call is sent.
54struct CallOptions {
55 /// @brief Ask the server to evaluate the action's body instead of executing it (spec 5 §7, `ui-evaluate`).
56 bool evaluate = false;
57 /// @brief The mutation declares `"offline": "queue"`: a dispatcher with an offline queue holds a call that cannot
58 /// reach the server and settles the completion when the replay settles.
59 bool queueOffline = false;
60};

100/// @brief Evaluates an action body without running it: the model's type id, the action id and the JSON body in, the
101/// query's value out (spec 5 §7). `ui::evaluatorOver` builds one over the UI service's `ui-evaluate`.
102using Evaluator = std::function<async::Completion<std::string>(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId,
103 std::string const& bodyJson)>;
104
105/// @brief A `Dispatcher` over the bridge's model-free seams: `bindByType`, `executeRaw` and the string-keyed
106/// `attach`, through `RawHandler`.
107///
108/// An evaluation goes through the `Evaluator` it was given, since that envelope belongs to the UI service, not the
109/// bridge; without one it is refused with a `std::runtime_error`. It has no offline queue: `queueOffline` is ignored.
110/// A shared binding without a key is bound unattached, which the bridge refuses at the first call; a document
111/// reaches it only for a stateful model whose alias says `"shared"`.
112class BridgeDispatcher final : public Dispatcher {
113public:
114 /// @brief Dispatches through @p bridge, and evaluates through @p evaluator.
115 /// @param bridge The bridge. Borrowed: it must outlive every channel.
116 /// @param cbExec The executor replies are delivered on: the runtime's owner. Borrowed.
117 /// @param evaluator What answers an `evaluate` query; empty to refuse them.
118 BridgeDispatcher(bridge::Bridge& bridge MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, exec::IExecutor* cbExec MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND,
119 Evaluator evaluator = {})
120 : _bridge{&bridge}, _cbExec{cbExec}, _evaluator{std::move(evaluator)} {}
121
122 /// @brief Binds through a `RawHandler`.
123 /// @param typeId The model's registered type id.
124 /// @param sharing Private, or shared.
125 /// @param instanceKey For a shared binding, the key to attach to; empty to stay unattached.
126 /// @return The channel; destroying it deregisters the binding.
127 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> bind(std::string const& typeId, bridge::BindSharing sharing,
128 std::string const& instanceKey) override {
129 return std::make_shared<Channel>(*_bridge, _cbExec, _evaluator, typeId, sharing, instanceKey);
130 }
131
132private:
133 class Channel final : public ModelChannel {
134 public:
135 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): the type id, then the key, as `bind` takes them.
136 Channel(bridge::Bridge& bridge, exec::IExecutor* cbExec, Evaluator evaluator, std::string const& typeId,
137 bridge::BindSharing sharing, std::string const& instanceKey)
138 : _cbExec{cbExec},
139 _evaluator{std::move(evaluator)},
140 _typeId{typeId},
141 _handler{bridge, cbExec, typeId, sharing, instanceKey} {}
142
143 [[nodiscard]] async::Completion<std::string> execute(std::string const& actionId, std::string const& bodyJson,
144 CallOptions options) override {
145 if (options.evaluate) {
146 if (_evaluator) {
147 return _evaluator(_typeId, actionId, bodyJson);
148 }
149 auto [refused, promise] = async::Completion<std::string>::makeSettleable(_cbExec);
150 promise.reject(std::make_exception_ptr(std::runtime_error{"evaluate needs the UI service"}));
151 return std::move(refused);
152 }
153 return _handler.execute(actionId, bodyJson);
154 }
155
156 private:
157 exec::IExecutor* _cbExec;
158 Evaluator _evaluator;
159 std::string _typeId;
160 bridge::RawHandler _handler;
161 };
162
163 bridge::Bridge* _bridge;
164 exec::IExecutor* _cbExec;
165 Evaluator _evaluator;
166};

364struct SessionOptions {
365 /// @brief Timers for `debounce`, `refreshEvery` and the cache's eviction. Without one, `debounce` fetches at once,

376 /// which knows the bridge's own failures and calls everything else `error`.
377 std::function<std::string(std::exception_ptr const&)> classify;
378};

382/// @brief The text of a failure.
383/// @param error The failure.
384/// @return `what()`, or `unknown error`.
385[[nodiscard]] inline std::string failureText(std::exception_ptr const& error) {
386 try {
387 std::rethrow_exception(error);
388 } catch (std::exception const& failure) {
389 return failure.what();
390 } catch (...) {
391 return "unknown error";
392 }
393}
394
395/// @brief The default error kinds: the bridge's own failures, and `error` for the rest.
396/// @param error The failure.
397/// @return The kind.
398[[nodiscard]] inline std::string defaultErrorKind(std::exception_ptr const& error) {
399 try {
400 std::rethrow_exception(error);
401 } catch (backend::DisconnectedError const&) {
402 return "offline";
403 } catch (backend::TimeoutError const&) {
404 return "timeout";
405 } catch (backend::ClientTimeoutError const&) {
406 return "timeout";
407 } catch (backend::BackendChangedError const&) {
408 return "backendChanged";
409 } catch (...) {
410 return "error";
411 }
412}

414/// @brief A value's JSON text, with record fields in name order: a cache key's canonical body.
415/// @param value The value.
416/// @return The text.
417[[nodiscard]] inline std::string canonicalJson(Value const& value) {
418 return glz::write_json(valueToJson(value)).value_or(std::string{});
419}
420
421/// @brief A value with the field at @p path replaced, creating records along the way.
422/// @param base The value written into.
423/// @param path The field path.
424/// @param value The new value at the path.
425/// @return The new value.
426// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per path segment
427[[nodiscard]] inline Value withPath(Value const& base, std::span<std::string const> path, Value value) {
428 if (path.empty()) {
429 return value;
430 }
431 ValueRecord fields;
432 if (ValueRecord const* const record = base.asRecord()) {
433 fields = *record;
434 }
435 Value const inner = base.field(path.front()) != nullptr ? *base.field(path.front()) : Value{};
436 fields.insert_or_assign(path.front(), withPath(inner, path.subspan(1), std::move(value)));
437 return Value{std::move(fields)};
438}
439
440/// @brief A row's identity for `patch` and `optimistic`: its `id` field.
441/// @param row The row.
442/// @return The `id` field, or `null`.
443[[nodiscard]] inline Value rowId(Value const& row) {
444 Value const* const found = row.field("id");
445 return found == nullptr ? Value{} : *found;
446}
447
448/// @brief Writes @p with over a row: the fields of a record over a record's, otherwise the whole row.
449/// @param row The row.
450/// @param with The new content.
451/// @return The new row.
452[[nodiscard]] inline Value mergeRow(Value const& row, Value const& with) {
453 ValueRecord const* const fields = row.asRecord();
454 ValueRecord const* const over = with.asRecord();
455 if (fields == nullptr || over == nullptr) {
456 return with;
457 }
458 ValueRecord merged = *fields;
459 for (auto const& [name, field] : *over) {
460 merged.insert_or_assign(name, field);
461 }
462 return Value{std::move(merged)};
463}
464
465/// @brief Replaces, in a list of rows, the row whose `id` equals @p key.
466/// @param rows The list.
467/// @param key The row's id.
468/// @param with The new content, merged over the row.
469/// @return The new list, or `std::nullopt` when no row matched or @p rows is not a list.
470// NOLINTNEXTLINE(bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters): a list, a key and a row are distinct roles of one type.
471[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<Value> patchRows(Value const& rows, Value const& key, Value const& with) {
472 ValueList const* const items = rows.asList();
473 if (items == nullptr || key.isNull()) {
474 return std::nullopt;
475 }
476 ValueList out = *items;
477 bool found = false;
478 for (Value& row : out) {
479 if (rowId(row) == key) {
480 row = mergeRow(row, with);
481 found = true;
482 }
483 }
484 if (!found) {
485 return std::nullopt;
486 }
487 return Value{std::move(out)};
488}
489
490/// @brief Removes the named fields from a record, and from each record of a list.
491/// @param value The value.
492/// @param fields The field names.
493/// @return The value without them.
494// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per nested list or record of the value.
495[[nodiscard]] inline Value withoutFields(Value const& value, std::vector<std::string> const& fields) {
496 if (fields.empty()) {
497 return value;
498 }
499 if (ValueRecord const* const record = value.asRecord()) {
500 ValueRecord kept = *record;
501 for (std::string const& field : fields) {
502 kept.erase(field);
503 }
504 return Value{std::move(kept)};
505 }
506 if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
507 ValueList kept;
508 kept.reserve(items->size());
509 for (Value const& item : *items) {
510 kept.push_back(withoutFields(item, fields));
511 }
512 return Value{std::move(kept)};
513 }
514 return value;
515}

517/// @brief One optimistic write still waiting for its reply.
518struct OptimisticLayer {
519 /// @brief The run that made it.
520 std::uint64_t run = 0;
521 /// @brief The row's id.
522 Value key;
523 /// @brief What was written.
524 Value with;
525};

527/// @brief One entry of the session's query cache (spec 5 §5): one request in flight, one value, one error.
528struct CacheEntry {
529 /// @brief An empty entry.
530 /// @param runtime The runtime its signals belong to.
531 explicit CacheEntry(reactive::Runtime& runtime)
532 : value{runtime}, hasValue{runtime, false}, error{runtime}, errorKind{runtime}, pending{runtime, false} {}
533
534 /// @brief The cache key: model type, instance, action and canonical body.
535 std::string key;
536 /// @brief The model type.
537 std::string typeId;
538 /// @brief The action.
539 std::string action;
540 /// @brief The body's JSON text.
541 std::string body;
542 /// @brief Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
543 bool evaluate = false;
544 /// @brief The value shown: the confirmed value with the optimistic layers over it.
545 reactive::Signal<Value> value;
546 /// @brief Whether a reply has been applied.
547 reactive::Signal<bool> hasValue;
548 /// @brief The last failure's text; empty when none.
549 reactive::Signal<std::string> error;
550 /// @brief The last failure's kind; empty when none.
551 reactive::Signal<std::string> errorKind;
552 /// @brief Whether a request is in flight.
553 reactive::Signal<bool> pending;
554 /// @brief The value the server last confirmed.
555 Value confirmed;
556 /// @brief The optimistic writes still waiting, oldest first.
557 std::vector<OptimisticLayer> layers;
558 /// @brief The generation of the request in flight; a reply of an older one is dropped.
559 std::uint64_t generation = 0;
560 /// @brief When the last reply was applied.
561 std::optional<std::chrono::milliseconds> fetchedAt;
562 /// @brief Marked stale by an invalidation, `refreshOn` or a backend switch.
563 bool stale = false;
564 /// @brief The mounted queries using it.
565 int users = 0;
566 /// @brief The eviction timer, while no query uses it.
567 reactive::TimerHandle evict;
568 /// @brief The fields never cached.
569 std::vector<std::string> secretFields;
570};

576/// @brief What screens of one client session share (spec 5 §5, §12b): the query cache, `refreshOn` bookkeeping, the
577/// principal's permitted actions, the formatting facts and the client's `env`, `session` and `host` values.
578///
579/// It belongs to the runtime's owner, outlives every screen mounted on it, and is cleared by `signOut` and on a
580/// principal change.
581class Session {
582public:
583 /// @brief An empty session.
584 /// @param runtime The runtime. Borrowed.
585 /// @param options Timers, clock and catalog.
586 explicit Session(reactive::Runtime& runtime MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, SessionOptions options = {})
587 : _runtime{&runtime},
588 _options{std::move(options)},
589 _permitted{runtime},
590 _format{runtime, std::make_shared<FormatContext const>()},
591 _env{runtime},
592 _sessionValues{runtime},
593 _hostValues{runtime} {}
594
595 Session(Session const&) = delete;
596 Session& operator=(Session const&) = delete;
597 Session(Session&&) = delete;
598 Session& operator=(Session&&) = delete;
599 ~Session() = default;
600
601 /// @brief The runtime.
602 /// @return It.
603 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Runtime& runtime() const noexcept { return *_runtime; }
604
605 /// @brief The options.
606 /// @return They.
607 [[nodiscard]] SessionOptions const& options() const noexcept { return _options; }
608
609 /// @brief Sets the action ids the principal may run, and the `host:<command>` names the client has, as the
610 /// catalog reply lists them; `{"can": ...}` follows them.
611 /// @param permitted The ids.
612 void setPermitted(std::set<std::string, std::less<>> permitted) { _permitted.set(std::move(permitted)); }
613
614 /// @brief Whether the principal may run an action, or the client has a host command. A tracked read.
615 /// @param action The action id, or `host:<command>`.
616 /// @return Whether it is permitted.
617 [[nodiscard]] bool can(std::string_view action) const { return _permitted.get().contains(action); }
618
619 /// @brief Replaces the formatting facts; every `t` and display function re-evaluates.
620 /// @param format The facts.
621 void setFormatting(FormatContext format) { _format.set(std::make_shared<FormatContext const>(std::move(format))); }
622
623 /// @brief The formatting facts. A tracked read.
624 /// @return They.
625 [[nodiscard]] FormatContext const& formatting() const { return *_format.get(); }
626
627 /// @brief Changes the active locale, keeping the other formatting facts.
628 /// @param locale The BCP 47 locale.
629 void setLocale(std::string locale) {
630 FormatContext next = *_format.peek();
631 next.locale = std::move(locale);
632 setFormatting(std::move(next));
633 }
634
635 /// @brief Sets the `env` values (`widthClass`, `locale`, `platform`, `online`, `backend`).
636 /// @param values The values.
637 void setEnvironment(ValueRecord values) { _env.set(std::move(values)); }
638
639 /// @brief Sets the `session` values (`principal`, `userName`, …).
640 /// @param values The values.
641 void setSessionValues(ValueRecord values) { _sessionValues.set(std::move(values)); }
642
643 /// @brief Sets the `host` values the application registered.
644 /// @param values The values.
645 void setHostValues(ValueRecord values) { _hostValues.set(std::move(values)); }
646
647 /// @brief Reads `env`, `session` or `host`. A tracked read.
648 /// @param form `Env`, `Session` or `Host`.
649 /// @param name The name.
650 /// @return The value, or `null`.
651 [[nodiscard]] Value client(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const {
652 ValueRecord const& values = [&]() -> ValueRecord const& {
653 if (form == ExprKind::Env) {
654 return _env.get();
655 }
656 return form == ExprKind::Session ? _sessionValues.get() : _hostValues.get();
657 }();
658 auto const found = values.find(name);
659 return found == values.end() ? Value{} : found->second;
660 }
661
662 /// @brief Drops every cache entry: `signOut` and a principal change (spec 5 §5, "Isolation").
663 void clear() {
664 _runtime->batch([this] {
665 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
666 static_cast<void>(key);
667 ++entry->generation;
668 entry->evict.cancel();
669 }
670 _entries.clear();
671 for (detail::QueryRuntime* const query : _mounted) {
672 detachQuery(*query);
673 }
674 });
675 }
676
677 /// @brief Marks every entry stale and refetches those a mounted query uses: a backend switch (spec 6 §9).
678 void backendChanged();
679
680 /// @brief Starts a query's request before its screen mounts, so the screen mounts on a warm cache.
681 /// @param channel The alias's channel.
682 /// @param token The alias's instance token (`Screen::instanceToken`).
683 /// @param typeId The model type.
684 /// @param action The action.
685 /// @param body The body.
686 void prefetch(std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const& channel, std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
687 std::string const& action, Value const& body) {
688 auto entry = acquire(token, typeId, action, false, body);
689 if (!entry->pending.peek() && (!entry->hasValue.peek() || entry->stale)) {
690 fetch(entry, channel);
691 }
692 release(entry);
693 }
694
695 /// @brief The number of entries in the cache.
696 /// @return It.
697 [[nodiscard]] std::size_t cacheSize() const noexcept { return _entries.size(); }
698
699 /// @brief A fresh instance token for a private alias: what the cache key holds for its instance.
700 /// @return It, unique in the session.
701 [[nodiscard]] std::string privateToken() { return "private#" + std::to_string(++_privateTokens); }
702
703 /// @brief Whether the newest write to a document source was made by a user event (spec 5 §6, `source: "user"`).
704 /// @return It.
705 [[nodiscard]] bool lastWriteByUser() const noexcept { return _lastWriteUser; }
706
707 /// @brief Records a write to a document source.
708 void noteWrite() noexcept { _lastWriteUser = _userDepth > 0; }
709
710 /// @brief Runs @p body as a user event: what it writes counts as the user's.
711 /// @param body The body.
712 void asUser(std::function<void()> const& body) {
713 ++_userDepth;
714 try {
715 body();
716 } catch (...) {
717 --_userDepth;
718 throw;
719 }
720 --_userDepth;
721 }
722
723 /// @brief The cache key of a query.
724 /// @param token The alias's instance token.
725 /// @param typeId The model type.
726 /// @param action The action.
727 /// @param evaluate Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
728 /// @param body The canonical body.
729 /// @return The key.
730 [[nodiscard]] static std::string cacheKey(std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
731 std::string const& action, bool evaluate, std::string const& body) {
732 return typeId + '\x1f' + token + '\x1f' + (evaluate ? "evaluate:" : "") + action + '\x1f' + body;
733 }
734
735 /// @brief Finds or makes an entry and counts one more user.
736 /// @param token The alias's instance token.
737 /// @param typeId The model type.
738 /// @param action The action.
739 /// @param evaluate Whether it is an `evaluate` query.
740 /// @param body The body.
741 /// @return The entry.
742 std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> acquire(std::string const& token, std::string const& typeId,
743 std::string const& action, bool evaluate, Value const& body) {
744 std::string const text = detail::canonicalJson(body);
745 std::string key = cacheKey(token, typeId, action, evaluate, text);
746 auto found = _entries.find(key);
747 if (found == _entries.end()) {
748 auto entry = std::make_shared<detail::CacheEntry>(*_runtime);
749 entry->key = key;
750 entry->typeId = typeId;
751 entry->action = action;
752 entry->body = text;
753 entry->evaluate = evaluate;
754 if (_options.catalog.action) {
755 if (auto const info = _options.catalog.action(action)) {
756 entry->secretFields = info->secretFields;
757 }
758 }
759 found = _entries.emplace(std::move(key), std::move(entry)).first;
760 }
761 ++found->second->users;
762 found->second->evict.cancel();
763 return found->second;
764 }
765
766 /// @brief Counts one user less; an entry nobody uses is dropped after `keepUnused`.
767 /// @param entry The entry.
768 void release(std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const& entry) {
769 if (--entry->users > 0 || _options.scheduler == nullptr) {
770 return;
771 }
772 std::weak_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const weak = entry;
773 entry->evict = _options.scheduler->after(_options.keepUnused, [this, weak] {
774 auto const held = weak.lock();
775 if (held && held->users == 0) {
776 _entries.erase(held->key);
777 }
778 });
779 }
780
781 /// @brief Sends an entry's request under a new generation; a reply of an older generation is dropped.
782 /// @param entry The entry.
783 /// @param channel The channel to send it through; `nullptr` fails the request at once.
784 void fetch(std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const& entry, std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const& channel) {
785 std::uint64_t const generation = ++entry->generation;
786 if (channel == nullptr) {
787 settleFailure(*entry, "the model alias has no instance", "error");
788 return;
789 }
790 entry->pending.set(true);
791 std::weak_ptr<detail::CacheEntry> const weak = entry;
792 try {
793 auto completion = channel->execute(entry->action, entry->body, CallOptions{.evaluate = entry->evaluate});
794 completion
795 .then([this, weak, generation](std::string const& reply) {
796 auto const held = weak.lock();
797 if (held && held->generation == generation) {
798 settleReply(*held, reply);
799 }
800 })
801 .onError([this, weak, generation](std::exception_ptr const& error) {
802 auto const held = weak.lock();
803 if (held && held->generation == generation) {
804 settleFailure(*held, detail::failureText(error), classify(error));
805 }
806 });
807 } catch (...) {
808 std::exception_ptr const error = std::current_exception();
809 settleFailure(*entry, detail::failureText(error), classify(error));
810 }
811 }
812
813 /// @brief Writes an entry's confirmed value and re-applies its optimistic layers over it.
814 /// @param entry The entry.
815 /// @param confirmed The confirmed value.
816 void confirm(detail::CacheEntry& entry, Value const& confirmed) {
817 entry.confirmed = detail::withoutFields(confirmed, entry.secretFields);
818 showLayers(entry);
819 }
820
821 /// @brief Recomputes what an entry shows from its confirmed value and its layers.
822 /// @param entry The entry.
823 void showLayers(detail::CacheEntry& entry) {
824 Value shown = entry.confirmed;
825 for (detail::OptimisticLayer const& layer : entry.layers) {
826 if (auto patched = detail::patchRows(shown, layer.key, layer.with)) {
827 shown = std::move(*patched);
828 }
829 }
830 noteWrite();
831 entry.value.set(std::move(shown));
832 }
833
834 /// @brief The error kind of a failure.
835 /// @param error The failure.
836 /// @return The kind.
837 [[nodiscard]] std::string classify(std::exception_ptr const& error) const {
838 return _options.classify ? _options.classify(error) : detail::defaultErrorKind(error);
839 }
840
841 /// @brief The clock.
842 /// @return Now.
843 [[nodiscard]] std::chrono::milliseconds now() const {
844 if (_options.clock) {
845 return _options.clock();
846 }
847 return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
848 std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch());
849 }
850
851 /// @brief Registers a mounted query, for `refreshOn` and invalidation.
852 /// @param query The query.
853 void attachQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query) { _mounted.push_back(&query); }
854
855 /// @brief Unregisters a mounted query.
856 /// @param query The query.
857 void forgetQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query) { std::erase(_mounted, &query); }
858
859 /// @brief A mutation of @p typeId running @p actionId succeeded: refetch every mounted query of that model type
860 /// whose `refreshOn` names it (spec 5 §5).
861 /// @param typeId The model type.
862 /// @param actionId The action.
863 void actionSucceeded(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId);
864
865private:
866 void settleReply(detail::CacheEntry& entry, std::string const& reply) {
867 auto json = parseJson(reply);
868 auto value = json ? valueFromJson(*json) : std::unexpected(json.error());
869 if (!value) {
870 settleFailure(entry, "the reply is not a document value: " + value.error(), "error");
871 return;
872 }
873 _runtime->batch([&] {
874 confirm(entry, *value);
875 entry.hasValue.set(true);
876 entry.error.set({});
877 entry.errorKind.set({});
878 entry.pending.set(false);
879 entry.fetchedAt = now();
880 entry.stale = false;
881 });
882 }
883
884 void settleFailure(detail::CacheEntry& entry, std::string text, std::string kind) {
885 _runtime->batch([&] {
886 noteWrite();
887 entry.error.set(std::move(text));
888 entry.errorKind.set(std::move(kind));
889 entry.pending.set(false);
890 });
891 }
892
893 static void detachQuery(detail::QueryRuntime& query);
894
895 reactive::Runtime* _runtime;
896 SessionOptions _options;
897 reactive::Signal<std::set<std::string, std::less<>>> _permitted;
898 reactive::Signal<std::shared_ptr<FormatContext const>> _format;
899 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> _env;
900 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> _sessionValues;
901 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> _hostValues;
902 std::map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<detail::CacheEntry>, std::less<>> _entries;
903 std::vector<detail::QueryRuntime*> _mounted;
904 int _userDepth = 0;
905 bool _lastWriteUser = false;
906 std::uint64_t _privateTokens = 0;
907};

909// Runtime structures

912/// @brief A model the opener lends to a screen whose alias says `{"from": alias}` (spec 6 §16).
913struct BorrowedModel {
914 /// @brief The opener's channel.
915 std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> channel;
916 /// @brief The opener's instance token, so the two share cache entries.
917 std::string token;
918};
919
920/// @brief What `Interpreter::mount` is given beside the document.
921struct MountOptions {
922 /// @brief The container the screen's root widget is appended to; `nullptr` makes a backend root.
923 ContainerWidget* parent = nullptr;
924 /// @brief The models the opener lends, by the alias of this screen that borrows them.
925 std::map<std::string, BorrowedModel, std::less<>> borrowed;
926 /// @brief The reactive scope depth of the screen's own scope.
927 std::size_t depth = 0;
928};

930namespace detail {
931
932/// @brief A name bound for the expressions of one place: a command's `event`, a step's `as`, `result` in a
933/// `patch`, `body` in an `optimistic`, `props` in a fallback, `boundary` in a boundary's `error`.
934struct Binding {
935 /// @brief The name.
936 std::string name;
937 /// @brief Reads its value; a tracked read for a reactive one.
938 std::function<Value()> read;
939};
940
941/// @brief The names bound at one place, innermost last.
942using Bindings = std::vector<Binding>;
943
944class ScreenCore;
945class RtScope;
946struct ElementState;
947class MutationRuntime;
948struct CheckRuntime;
949struct BoundaryRuntime;

951/// @brief One state declaration at run time.
952struct StateSlot {
953 /// @brief The declaration.
954 StateDecl const* decl = nullptr;
955 /// @brief The value, made when the init is evaluated.
956 std::unique_ptr<reactive::Signal<Value>> value;
957 /// @brief The scope that declares it, where its init is evaluated.
958 RtScope const* scope = nullptr;
959 /// @brief Set while the init is evaluated, so a cyclic read gives `null` instead of recursing.
960 bool initializing = false;
961};

963/// @brief One model alias at run time: the instance it names, and the channel bound to it.
964struct ModelAlias {
965 /// @brief The declaration.
966 ModelDecl const* decl = nullptr;
967 /// @brief `Private`, `Shared`, `Keyed` or `Borrowed`, the default resolved through the catalog.
968 InstanceMode mode = InstanceMode::Private;
969 /// @brief The instance token: what the cache key holds for the instance; empty while unbound (a `null` key).
970 reactive::Computed<std::string>* token = nullptr;

976
977/// @brief The values of an `upload` transfer id (spec 6 §18).
978struct TransferState {
979 /// @brief An idle transfer.
980 /// @param runtime The runtime.
981 explicit TransferState(reactive::Runtime& runtime) : progress{runtime}, pending{runtime, false}, error{runtime} {}
982 /// @brief 0 to 1, or `null`.
983 reactive::Signal<Value> progress;
984 /// @brief Whether it is running.
985 reactive::Signal<bool> pending;
986 /// @brief The failure's text, or `null`.

988};
989
990/// @brief An element's live values (spec 5 §6).
991struct ElementState {
992 /// @brief The element's state before any user action.
993 /// @param runtime The runtime.
994 explicit ElementState(reactive::Runtime& runtime)
995 : draft{runtime},
996 committed{runtime},
997 edited{runtime, false},
998 touched{runtime, false},
999 focused{runtime, false},
1000 open{runtime, false},
1001 submitted{runtime, false},
1002 selection{runtime, Value{ValueList{}}},
1003 activeKey{runtime},
1004 checksVersion{runtime, 0},
1005 inner{runtime, nullptr} {}
1006
1007 /// @brief The node.
1008 DocNode const* node = nullptr;
1009 /// @brief The scope that declares it.
1010 RtScope* scope = nullptr;
1011 /// @brief What the user is editing: a text input's text, a checkbox's state, a select's key, a slider's number,
1012 /// a date-time input's timestamp.
1013 reactive::Signal<Value> draft;
1014 /// @brief The committed value of an input whose value no expression binds.
1015 reactive::Signal<Value> committed;
1016 /// @brief Whether the user changed the draft since it last followed the bound value.
1017 reactive::Signal<bool> edited;
1018 /// @brief Whether it has been committed at least once (Enter or focus leaving after an edit).
1019 reactive::Signal<bool> touched;
1020 /// @brief Whether it has keyboard focus. The view tree reports no focus, so it stays false.
1021 reactive::Signal<bool> focused;
1022 /// @brief A dialog's or drawer's `open`, set by `open` and `close`.
1023 reactive::Signal<bool> open;
1024 /// @brief A dialog's or drawer's `submitted`.
1025 reactive::Signal<bool> submitted;
1026 /// @brief A table's selected keys.
1027 reactive::Signal<Value> selection;
1028 /// @brief A table's last activated key.
1029 reactive::Signal<Value> activeKey;
1030 /// @brief Bumped when a check targeting it comes or goes.
1031 reactive::Signal<int> checksVersion;
1032 /// @brief A dialog's or drawer's scope while its content is mounted.
1033 reactive::Signal<RtScope*> inner;
1034 /// @brief The checks targeting it.
1035 std::vector<CheckRuntime*> checks;
1036 /// @brief The value an expression binds (`value`, `checked`, `selected`); `nullptr` when the element is
1037 /// uncontrolled.
1038 reactive::Computed<Value>* bound = nullptr;
1039 /// @brief What is wrong now, as a list of strings: `required` unmet, the node's `errors`, the reply's field
1040 /// errors and the failing checks' messages.
1041 reactive::Computed<Value>* errors = nullptr;
1042 /// @brief A table's rows or a select's options, for its counts and `selectedOption`.
1043 reactive::Computed<Value>* rows = nullptr;
1044};
1045
1046/// @brief One check at run time.
1047struct CheckRuntime {
1048 /// @brief The declaration.
1049 CheckDecl const* decl = nullptr;
1050 /// @brief Whether `assert` is `false`.
1051 reactive::Computed<bool>* failing = nullptr;
1052 /// @brief The message, as text.
1053 reactive::Computed<std::string>* message = nullptr;
1054 /// @brief The elements it targets.
1055 std::vector<ElementState*> targets;
1056
1057 CheckRuntime() = default;
1058 CheckRuntime(CheckRuntime const&) = delete;
1059 CheckRuntime& operator=(CheckRuntime const&) = delete;
1060 CheckRuntime(CheckRuntime&&) = delete;
1061 CheckRuntime& operator=(CheckRuntime&&) = delete;
1062
1063 /// @brief Leaves its targets.
1064 ~CheckRuntime() {
1065 for (ElementState* const target : targets) {
1066 std::erase(target->checks, this);
1067 target->checksVersion.set(target->checksVersion.peek() + 1);
1068 }
1069 }
1070};

1072/// @brief One declared name of a run-time scope.

1084 /// @brief The query.
1085 QueryRuntime* query = nullptr;
1086 /// @brief The mutation.
1087 MutationRuntime* mutation = nullptr;
1088 /// @brief The model alias.
1089 ModelAlias* model = nullptr;
1090 /// @brief The element.
1091 ElementState* element = nullptr;
1092 /// @brief The transfer.
1093 TransferState* transfer = nullptr;
1094};

1102/// @brief One document scope at run time: the screen, a dialog's or drawer's content, a switch case or a row.
1103///
1104/// It lives while anything that reads it does: the view nodes lowered in it hold it by `shared_ptr`, a reply or
1105/// a timer holds it weakly. It belongs to a `ScreenCore`, which outlives it.
1106class RtScope : public std::enable_shared_from_this<RtScope> {
1107public:
1108 /// @brief An empty scope.
1109 /// @param screen The screen.
1110 /// @param enclosing The enclosing scope; `nullptr` for the screen and a component fallback.
1111 /// @param current The row of a row scope; `nullptr` otherwise.
1112 /// @param depth The reactive scope depth of what it owns.
1113 RtScope(ScreenCore& screen, std::shared_ptr<RtScope> enclosing, reactive::Signal<Value> const* current,
1114 std::size_t depth);
1115
1116 RtScope(RtScope const&) = delete;
1117 RtScope& operator=(RtScope const&) = delete;
1118 RtScope(RtScope&&) = delete;
1119 RtScope& operator=(RtScope&&) = delete;
1120
1121 /// @brief Releases what it owns, and tells the dialog it belongs to.
1122 ~RtScope();
1123
1124 /// @brief Resolves a name, innermost scope first.
1125 /// @param name The name.
1126 /// @return The declaration, or `nullptr`.
1127 [[nodiscard]] NameRef const* find(std::string_view name) const {
1128 for (RtScope const* scope = this; scope != nullptr; scope = scope->parent.get()) {
1129 auto const found = scope->names.find(name);
1130 if (found != scope->names.end()) {
1131 return &found->second;
1132 }
1133 }
1134 return nullptr;
1135 }
1136
1137 /// @brief The innermost row, from this scope outwards.
1138 /// @return The row signal, or `nullptr`.
1139 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Signal<Value> const* innermostRow() const {
1140 for (RtScope const* scope = this; scope != nullptr; scope = scope->parent.get()) {
1141 if (scope->row != nullptr) {
1142 return scope->row;
1143 }
1144 }
1145 return nullptr;
1146 }
1147
1148 /// @brief The innermost scope that decides when errors show and is submitted: a dialog's, or the screen's.
1149 /// @return The scope.
1150 [[nodiscard]] RtScope const& policyScope() const {
1151 RtScope const* scope = this;
1152 while (scope->submitted == nullptr && scope->parent != nullptr) {
1153 scope = scope->parent.get();
1154 }
1155 return *scope;
1156 }
1157
1158 /// @brief Whether every element of the scope is valid and no blocking check of it fails. A tracked read.
1159 /// @return It.
1160 [[nodiscard]] bool ready() const;
1161
1162 /// @brief The screen.
1163 ScreenCore& core;
1164 /// @brief The enclosing scope.
1165 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> parent;
1166 /// @brief The row of a row scope.
1167 reactive::Signal<Value> const* row = nullptr;
1168 /// @brief The dialog or drawer whose content it is.
1169 ElementState* owner = nullptr;
1170 /// @brief `touched`, `submit` or `always`, for a scope that decides it.
1171 std::string showErrors;
1172 /// @brief `submitted` of a scope that decides when errors show.
1173 reactive::Signal<bool>* submitted = nullptr;
1174 /// @brief Its names.
1175 std::map<std::string, NameRef, std::less<>> names;
1176 /// @brief Its state.
1177 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<StateSlot>> states;
1178 /// @brief Its elements, in document order.
1179 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ElementState>> elements;
1180 /// @brief Its transfers.
1181 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<TransferState>> transfers;
1182 /// @brief Its model aliases.
1183 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ModelAlias>> models;
1184 /// @brief Its queries.
1185 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<QueryRuntime>> queries;
1186 /// @brief Its mutations.
1187 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<MutationRuntime>> mutations;
1188 /// @brief Its checks.
1189 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<CheckRuntime>> checks;
1190 /// @brief The reactive nodes it owns; declared last, so they go first.
1191 reactive::Scope nodes;
1192};

1194/// @brief The `Environment` the evaluator reads through: a scope chain and the names bound at one place.
1195class ScopeEnv final : public Environment {
1196public:
1197 /// @brief Reads @p scope.
1198 /// @param scope The scope.
1199 /// @param bindings The names bound here; may be `nullptr`.
1200 /// @param row A row to read instead of the scope's (a table's `key`, evaluated before its row scope exists).
1201 ScopeEnv(RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings, Value const* row = nullptr)
1202 : _scope{&scope}, _bindings{bindings}, _row{row} {}
1203
1204 /// @brief Reads a name: a binding, then the scope chain.
1205 /// @param head The name.
1206 /// @param path The path after it.
1207 /// @return The value.
1208 [[nodiscard]] Value ref(std::string_view head, std::span<std::string const> path) const override;
1209
1210 /// @brief Reads the innermost row.
1211 /// @param path The path.
1212 /// @return The value.
1213 [[nodiscard]] Value row(std::span<std::string const> path) const override {
1214 if (_row != nullptr) {
1215 return walk(*_row, path);
1216 }
1217 reactive::Signal<Value> const* const current = _scope->innermostRow();
1218 return current == nullptr ? Value{} : walk(current->get(), path);
1219 }
1220
1221 /// @brief Reads a query or mutation form.
1222 /// @param form The form.
1223 /// @param name The query or mutation.
1224 /// @return The value.
1225 [[nodiscard]] Value control(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const override;
1226
1227 /// @brief Reads a customization choice.
1228 /// @param point The point.
1229 /// @param path The path.
1230 /// @return The value.
1231 [[nodiscard]] Value pref(std::string_view point, std::span<std::string const> path) const override;
1232
1233 /// @brief Reads `env`, `session` or `host`.
1234 /// @param form The form.
1235 /// @param name The name.
1236 /// @return The value.
1237 [[nodiscard]] Value client(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const override;
1238
1239 /// @brief The session's formatting facts.
1240 /// @return They.
1241 [[nodiscard]] FormatContext const& formatting() const override;
1242
1243 /// @brief Reports to the screen's diagnostics.
1244 /// @param path The expression's path.
1245 /// @param reason What went wrong.
1246 void report(std::string_view path, std::string_view reason) const override;
1247
1248private:
1249 RtScope const* _scope;
1250 Bindings const* _bindings;
1251 Value const* _row;
1252};
1253
1254/// @brief Evaluates an expression in a scope.
1255/// @param scope The scope.
1256/// @param bindings The names bound here; may be `nullptr`.
1257/// @param expr The expression; `nullptr` evaluates to `null`.
1258/// @return The value.
1259[[nodiscard]] inline Value evalIn(RtScope const& scope, Bindings const* bindings, ExprPtr const& expr) {
1260 if (!expr) {
1261 return Value{};
1262 }
1263 ScopeEnv const env{scope, bindings};
1264 return evaluate(*expr, env);
1265}
1266
1267/// @brief Whether a value counts as given for `required`: not `null`, not an empty string or list.
1268/// @param value The value.
1269/// @return It.
1270[[nodiscard]] inline bool engaged(Value const& value) {
1271 if (value.isNull()) {
1272 return false;
1273 }
1274 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1275 return !text->empty();
1276 }
1277 if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
1278 return !items->empty();
1279 }
1280 return true;
1281}
1282
1283/// @brief A value as text for a widget: a string as itself, a number in the locale, a timestamp in ISO 8601,
1284/// `null` as nothing, anything else as JSON.
1285/// @param value The value.
1286/// @param format The formatting facts.
1287/// @return The text.
1288[[nodiscard]] inline std::string textOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
1289 if (value.isNull()) {
1290 return {};
1291 }
1292 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1293 return *text;
1294 }
1295 if (bool const* const flag = value.asBool()) {
1296 return *flag ? "true" : "false";
1297 }
1298 if (Quantity const* const quantity = value.asQuantity()) {
1299 return formatNumber(value, format.numeric).value_or(std::string{}) + " " +
1300 unitDisplay(quantity->unit, format.units);
1301 }
1302 if (auto number = formatNumber(value, format.numeric)) {
1303 return *std::move(number);
1304 }
1305 if (time::DateTime const* const instant = value.asTimestamp()) {
1306 return instant->toIso8601();
1307 }
1308 return canonicalJson(value);
1309}
1310
1311/// @brief A value as a view key: an `int` or a string as itself, anything else as its JSON text.
1312/// @param value The value.
1313/// @return The key.
1314[[nodiscard]] inline Key keyOf(Value const& value) {
1315 if (std::int64_t const* const number = value.asInt()) {
1316 return Key{*number};
1317 }
1318 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1319 return Key{*text};
1320 }
1321 return Key{canonicalJson(value)};
1322}
1323
1324/// @brief A view key as a value.
1325/// @param key The key.
1326/// @return An `int` or a string.
1327[[nodiscard]] inline Value valueOfKey(Key const& key) {
1328 if (std::int64_t const* const number = std::get_if<std::int64_t>(&key)) {
1329 return Value{*number};
1330 }
1331 return Value{std::get<std::string>(key)};
1332}
1333
1334/// @brief A list of strings out of a value: a string, a list of strings, or nothing.
1335/// @param value The value.
1336/// @return The strings.
1337[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<std::string> stringsOf(Value const& value) {
1338 std::vector<std::string> out;
1339 if (std::string const* const text = value.asString()) {
1340 out.push_back(*text);
1341 } else if (ValueList const* const items = value.asList()) {
1342 for (Value const& item : *items) {
1343 if (std::string const* const element = item.asString()) {
1344 out.push_back(*element);
1345 }
1346 }
1347 }
1348 return out;
1349}
1350
1351/// @brief A list of strings as a value.
1352/// @param texts The strings.
1353/// @return The list.
1354[[nodiscard]] inline Value listOfStrings(std::vector<std::string> const& texts) {
1355 ValueList items;
1356 items.reserve(texts.size());
1357 for (std::string const& text : texts) {
1358 items.emplace_back(text);
1359 }
1360 return Value{std::move(items)};
1361}
1362
1363/// @brief A query at run time (spec 5 §5): a key over the scope, an entry of the session's cache, latest wins.
1364class QueryRuntime {
1365public:
1366 /// @brief A query of @p scope, not yet started.
1367 /// @param decl The declaration.
1368 /// @param scope The scope.
1369 /// @param alias The model alias it goes through.
1370 QueryRuntime(QueryDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias);
1371
1372 QueryRuntime(QueryRuntime const&) = delete;
1373 QueryRuntime& operator=(QueryRuntime const&) = delete;
1374 QueryRuntime(QueryRuntime&&) = delete;
1375 QueryRuntime& operator=(QueryRuntime&&) = delete;
1376
1377 /// @brief Stops its timers and releases its entry.
1378 ~QueryRuntime();
1379
1380 /// @brief Starts it: makes its key and the Effect that follows it, and its refresh timer.
1381 void start();
1382
1383 /// @brief The value: the entry's, kept from the previous key while the new one has none. A tracked read.
1384 /// @return It.
1385 [[nodiscard]] Value value() const;
1386
1387 /// @brief Whether a request is in flight or waiting out its debounce. A tracked read.
1388 /// @return It.
1389 [[nodiscard]] bool pending() const;
1390
1391 /// @brief The failure's text, `null` when none. A tracked read.
1392 /// @return It.
1393 [[nodiscard]] Value error() const;
1394
1395 /// @brief The failure's kind, `null` when none. A tracked read.
1396 /// @return It.
1397 [[nodiscard]] Value errorKind() const;
1398
1399 /// @brief Whether the query has a value or a failure for its current key, or is idle. A tracked read, for a
1400 /// boundary.
1401 /// @return It.
1402 [[nodiscard]] bool settled() const;
1403
1404 /// @brief Refetches the current key now, ending a debounce wait.
1405 void refetch();
1406
1407 /// @brief Marks its entry stale and refetches it.
1408 void invalidate() {
1409 if (auto const& current = _entry.peek()) {
1410 current->stale = true;
1411 }
1412 refetch();
1413 }
1414
1415 /// @brief Forgets its entry without releasing it: the session dropped the cache.
1416 void detach() {
1417 _entry.set(nullptr);
1418 _carried.set(Value{});
1419 _target = {};
1420 }
1421
1422 /// @brief The current entry. A tracked read.
1423 /// @return It, or `nullptr` while idle.
1424 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry> const& entry() const { return _entry.get(); }
1425
1426 /// @brief The declaration.
1427 /// @return It.
1428 [[nodiscard]] QueryDecl const& decl() const noexcept { return *_decl; }
1429
1430 /// @brief The model type.
1431 /// @return It.
1432 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& typeId() const noexcept { return _typeId; }
1433
1434 /// @brief The channel its alias is bound to now.
1435 /// @return It, or `nullptr` while the alias is unbound.
1436 [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> channel() const;
1437
1438private:
1439 /// @brief What a key evaluates to: the cache entry it names and the body, or idle.
1440 struct Target {
1441 bool idle = true;
1442 std::string token;
1443 Value body;
1444 std::string bodyText;
1445 bool operator==(Target const& other) const {
1446 return idle == other.idle && token == other.token && bodyText == other.bodyText;
1447 }
1448 };
1449
1450 void switchTo(Target const& target);
1451
1452 QueryDecl const* _decl;
1453 std::string _typeId;
1454 RtScope* _scope;
1455 ModelAlias* _alias;
1456 reactive::Signal<std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry>> _entry;
1457 reactive::Signal<Value> _carried;
1458 reactive::Signal<bool> _waiting;
1459 Target _target;
1460 Target _pendingTarget;
1461 reactive::TimerHandle _debounce;
1462 reactive::TimerHandle _refresh;
1463 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
1464};
1465
1466/// @brief One run of a mutation, as a command sees it: whether it succeeded, and the reply.
1467using RunDone = std::function<void(bool succeeded, Value const& reply)>;
1468
1469/// @brief A mutation at run time (spec 5 §5): concurrency, patch, optimistic writes, invalidation.
1470class MutationRuntime {
1471public:
1472 /// @brief A mutation of @p scope.
1473 /// @param decl The declaration.
1474 /// @param scope The scope.
1475 /// @param alias The model alias it goes through.
1476 MutationRuntime(MutationDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias);
1477
1478 MutationRuntime(MutationRuntime const&) = delete;
1479 MutationRuntime& operator=(MutationRuntime const&) = delete;
1480 MutationRuntime(MutationRuntime&&) = delete;
1481 MutationRuntime& operator=(MutationRuntime&&) = delete;
1482
1483 /// @brief Drops the replies still to come.
1484 ~MutationRuntime() { *_alive = false; }
1485
1486 /// @brief Runs it, queues the run or refuses it, as its concurrency says.
1487 /// @param body The body.
1488 /// @param bindings The names bound where the run was started, for `onSuccess` and `onError`.
1489 /// @param done Called once the run settles, or at once when it is refused.
1490 void run(Value body, std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings, RunDone done);
1491
1492 /// @brief Whether a run is in flight or queued. A tracked read.
1493 /// @return It.
1494 [[nodiscard]] bool pending() const { return _inFlight.get() > 0; }
1495
1496 /// @brief The last applied result. A tracked read.
1497 /// @return It.
1498 [[nodiscard]] Value result() const { return _result.get(); }
1499
1500 /// @brief The last applied failure's text, or `null`. A tracked read.
1501 /// @return It.
1502 [[nodiscard]] Value error() const { return _error.get(); }
1503
1504 /// @brief The last applied failure's kind, or `null`. A tracked read.
1505 /// @return It.
1506 [[nodiscard]] Value errorKind() const { return _errorKind.get(); }
1507
1508 /// @brief The declaration.
1509 /// @return It.
1510 [[nodiscard]] MutationDecl const& decl() const noexcept { return *_decl; }
1511
1512 /// @brief The model type.
1513 /// @return It.
1514 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& typeId() const noexcept { return _typeId; }
1515
1516private:
1517 struct Run {
1518 std::uint64_t id = 0;
1519 Value body;
1520 std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings;
1521 RunDone done;
1522 std::string serialKey;
1523 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry>> layered;
1524 };
1525
1526 void send(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run);
1527 void settle(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run, std::optional<Value> reply, std::exception_ptr const& error);
1528 void next(std::string const& serialKey);
1529 void applyOptimistic(Run& run);
1530 void dropLayers(Run& run);
1531
1532 MutationDecl const* _decl;
1533 RtScope* _scope;
1534 ModelAlias* _alias;
1535 std::string _typeId;
1536 reactive::Signal<int> _inFlight;
1537 reactive::Signal<Value> _result;
1538 reactive::Signal<Value> _error;
1539 reactive::Signal<Value> _errorKind;
1540 std::uint64_t _runs = 0;
1541 std::uint64_t _latest = 0;
1542 std::map<std::string, std::deque<std::shared_ptr<Run>>, std::less<>> _queues;
1543 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> _busy;
1544 std::shared_ptr<bool> _alive = std::make_shared<bool>(true);
1545};

1549/// @brief What an `Interpreter` is built with.
1550struct InterpreterOptions {
1551 /// @brief The application's side of the commands; `nullptr` answers every one "not supported". Borrowed.
1552 InterpreterHost* host = nullptr;
1553 /// @brief Called with each diagnostic as it is reported: a runtime expression error, a command the host does not
1554 /// support, a node kind this interpreter does not lower.
1555 std::function<void(Refusal const&)> diagnostics;
1556};

1558namespace detail {
1559
1560/// @brief Where a command list runs: its scope, the names bound there, and what it may answer.
1561struct CommandCtx {
1562 /// @brief The scope.
1563 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> scope;
1564 /// @brief The names bound here; a `seq` step's `as` adds to them.
1565 std::shared_ptr<Bindings> bindings;
1566 /// @brief Set by `cancelClose`.
1567 std::shared_ptr<bool> cancelClose;
1568 /// @brief The innermost boundary, for `retry`.
1569 std::shared_ptr<BoundaryRuntime> boundary;
1570};
1571
1572/// @brief A command context without its scope: what a callback the host keeps may hold, so that the host never
1573/// keeps a scope alive past its screen. The callback holds the scope weakly and puts it back.
1574/// @param ctx The context.
1575/// @return The context, its scope dropped.
1576[[nodiscard]] inline CommandCtx detached(CommandCtx const& ctx) {
1577 CommandCtx kept = ctx;
1578 kept.scope = nullptr;
1579 return kept;
1580}
1581
1582/// @brief Called once when a command finishes: whether it succeeded.
1583using Done = std::function<void(bool)>;
1584
1585/// @brief Where a node is lowered: its scope, the names bound there and the boundary that owns its queries.
1586struct LowerCtx {
1587 /// @brief The scope.
1588 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> scope;
1589 /// @brief The names bound here.
1590 std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings;
1591 /// @brief The innermost boundary.
1592 std::shared_ptr<BoundaryRuntime> boundary;
1593};

1595/// @brief A kind's key spec, from the kind table.
1596/// @param kind The kind spec.
1597/// @param key The key.
1598/// @return The spec, or `nullptr` when the kind has no such key of its own.
1599[[nodiscard]] inline KeySpec const* keySpec(KindSpec const& kind, std::string_view key) {
1600 for (KeySpec const& spec : kind.keys) {
1601 if (spec.key == key) {
1602 return &spec;
1603 }
1604 }
1605 return nullptr;
1606}
1607
1608/// @brief Whether a node kind keeps per-element state even without an id: the inputs, dialogs and tables.
1609/// @param kind The kind.
1610/// @return It.
1611[[nodiscard]] inline bool statefulKind(std::string_view kind) {
1612 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 9> kStateful = {
1613 "textInput", "checkbox", "select", "dateTimeInput", "slider", "filePicker", "dialog", "drawer", "table"};
1614 return listed(kStateful, kind);
1615}

1617/// @brief One mounted screen's interpreter: its document, diagnostics, slots and preferences, and the code that
1618/// declares scopes, lowers nodes and runs commands.
1619class ScreenCore {
1620public:
1621 /// @brief The core of a screen about to mount.
1622 /// @param doc The document.
1623 /// @param owner The session.
1624 /// @param calls The dispatcher.
1625 /// @param options The interpreter's options.
1626 /// @param mount The mount's options.
1627 ScreenCore(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc, Session& owner, Dispatcher& calls,
1628 InterpreterOptions const& options, MountOptions const& mount)
1629 : session{owner},
1630 dispatcher{calls},
1631 host{options.host},
1632 onDiagnostic{options.diagnostics},
1633 borrowed{mount.borrowed},
1634 depth{mount.depth},
1635 prefs{session.runtime()},
1636 submitted{session.runtime(), false},
1637 _doc{std::move(doc)} {
1638 ValueRecord defaults;
1639 for (auto const& [name, point] : _doc->customize) {
1640 defaults.insert_or_assign(name, point.defaultValue);
1641 }
1642 prefDefaults = defaults;
1643 prefs.set(std::move(defaults));
1644 }
1645
1646 ScreenCore(ScreenCore const&) = delete;
1647 ScreenCore& operator=(ScreenCore const&) = delete;
1648 ScreenCore(ScreenCore&&) = delete;
1649 ScreenCore& operator=(ScreenCore&&) = delete;
1650 ~ScreenCore() = default;
1651
1652 /// @brief The document.
1653 /// @return It.
1654 [[nodiscard]] Document const& doc() const noexcept { return *_doc; }
1655
1656 /// @brief The runtime.
1657 /// @return It.
1658 [[nodiscard]] reactive::Runtime& runtime() const noexcept { return session.runtime(); }
1659
1660 /// @brief Reports a diagnostic once per path.
1661 /// @param path Where.
1662 /// @param reason What.
1663 void report(std::string_view path, std::string_view reason) {
1664 std::string key = std::string{path} + '\x1f' + std::string{reason};
1665 if (!reported.insert(std::move(key)).second) {
1666 return;
1667 }
1668 Refusal const refusal{.document = _doc->id, .path = std::string{path}, .reason = std::string{reason}};
1669 diagnostics.push_back(refusal);
1670 if (onDiagnostic) {
1671 onDiagnostic(refusal);
1672 }
1673 }
1674
1675 /// @brief The next slot id: the interpreter numbers every bound property of the document.
1676 /// @return It.
1677 [[nodiscard]] SlotId nextSlot() noexcept { return _slots++; }
1678
1679 // --- Declaring a scope -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1680
1681 /// @brief Declares a scope's names and starts its reactive parts.
1682 /// @param scope The scope.
1683 /// @param decl Its declarations; `nullptr` when it declares none.
1684 /// @param content The nodes whose elements belong to it.
1685 /// @param commands The command lists whose transfers belong to it.
1686 void declare(RtScope& scope, ScopeDecl const* decl, std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content,
1687 std::vector<Commands const*> const& commands);
1688
1689 /// @brief Makes a state's signal from its init, once.
1690 /// @param scope The scope that declares it.
1691 /// @param slot The state.
1692 void initState(RtScope const& scope, StateSlot& slot) const {
1693 if (slot.value || slot.initializing) {
1694 return;
1695 }
1696 slot.initializing = true;
1697 Value init = runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, slot.decl->init); });
1698 slot.value = std::make_unique<reactive::Signal<Value>>(runtime(), std::move(init));
1699 slot.initializing = false;
1700 }
1701
1702 /// @brief Reads an element value. A tracked read.
1703 /// @param element The element.
1704 /// @param name The value's name.
1705 /// @return The value.
1706 [[nodiscard]] Value elementValue(ElementState const& element, std::string_view name) const;
1707
1708 /// @brief The current value of an input, checkbox or select: what `required` tests.
1709 /// @param element The element.
1710 /// @return The value.
1711 [[nodiscard]] Value inputValue(ElementState const& element) const;
1712
1713 // --- Commands ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1714
1715 /// @brief Runs a command list: each command in order in one batch; done when every command in it is.
1716 /// @param commands The list.
1717 /// @param ctx Where it runs.
1718 /// @param done Called once, with whether every command succeeded; may be empty.
1719 void runList(Commands const& commands, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done);
1720
1721 /// @brief Runs one command.
1722 /// @param command The command.
1723 /// @param ctx Where it runs.
1724 /// @param done Called once, with whether it succeeded.
1725 void runOne(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done);
1726
1727 /// @brief Runs a command list for an event of the user's.
1728 /// @param commands The list; `nullptr` runs nothing.
1729 /// @param ctx Where it was lowered.
1730 /// @param event The event's payload.
1731 void runEvent(Commands const* commands, LowerCtx const& ctx, Value event) {
1732 if (commands == nullptr || commands->empty()) {
1733 return;
1734 }
1735 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings);
1736 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = "event", .read = [event = std::move(event)] { return event; }});
1737 CommandCtx const command{.scope = ctx.scope,
1738 .bindings = std::move(bindings),
1739 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
1740 .boundary = ctx.boundary};
1741 session.asUser([&] { runtime().batch([&] { runList(*commands, command, {}); }); });
1742 }
1743
1744 // --- Lowering ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1745
1746 /// @brief Lowers a document node to a view node.
1747 /// @param node The node.
1748 /// @param ctx Where.
1749 /// @return The view node.
1750 [[nodiscard]] Node lower(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
1751
1752 /// @brief Lowers a node list into one node: the node itself, or a column of them.
1753 /// @param nodes The nodes.
1754 /// @param ctx Where.
1755 /// @return The node.
1756 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per nested node of the document.
1757 [[nodiscard]] Node lowerAll(std::span<DocNodePtr const> nodes, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
1758 if (nodes.size() == 1) {
1759 return lower(*nodes.front(), ctx);
1760 }
1761 Column column;
1762 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
1763 column.children.push_back(lower(*child, ctx));
1764 }
1765 return ui::column(std::move(column));
1766 }
1767
1768 // NOLINTBEGIN(cppcoreguidelines-non-private-member-variables-in-classes): the screen's shared state, which its
1769 // scopes and runtimes read and write directly.
1770 /// @brief The session.
1771 Session& session;
1772 /// @brief The dispatcher.
1773 Dispatcher& dispatcher;
1774 /// @brief The host; may be `nullptr`.
1775 InterpreterHost* host;
1776 /// @brief The diagnostic callback.
1777 std::function<void(Refusal const&)> onDiagnostic;
1778 /// @brief The models the opener lends.
1779 std::map<std::string, BorrowedModel, std::less<>> borrowed;
1780 /// @brief The screen scope's reactive depth.
1781 std::size_t depth;
1782 /// @brief The diagnostics reported, in order.
1783 std::vector<Refusal> diagnostics;
1784 /// @brief The paths and reasons already reported.
1785 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> reported;
1786 /// @brief The customization choices, by point.
1787 reactive::Signal<ValueRecord> prefs;
1788 /// @brief The points' defaults.
1789 ValueRecord prefDefaults;
1790 /// @brief The screen's `submitted`.
1791 reactive::Signal<bool> submitted;
1792 // NOLINTEND(cppcoreguidelines-non-private-member-variables-in-classes)
1793
1794private:
1795 void wireElement(ElementState& element);
1796 void wireErrors(ElementState& element);
1797 void collect(DocNode const& node, RtScope& scope, std::vector<Commands const*>& commands);
1798 Node lowerKind(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
1799 Node lowerDialog(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
1800 Node lowerSwitch(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);
1801 Node lowerRows(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element);
1802 Node lowerBoundary(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);

1804 Node lowerCustomize(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx);

1806 std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content);
1807 void commonOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element, Common& common);
1808 void fieldOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element, FieldState& field);
1809 std::vector<MenuItem> menuItems(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx);
1810 void ownQueries(DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope, BoundaryRuntime& boundary,
1811 std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& seen);
1812 void ownQueriesOf(ExprPtr const& expr, RtScope const& scope, BoundaryRuntime& boundary,
1813 std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& seen);

1815 void runSet(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done);
1816 void runReset(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done);
1817 void runHostCommand(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done);
1818 void runTransfer(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done);

1824 /// @brief A bound property: a constant for a literal, a numbered slot otherwise.
1825 template <typename T, typename Convert>
1826 Prop<T> bindProp(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr, T fallback, Convert convert) {
1827 if (!expr) {
1828 return Prop<T>{std::move(fallback)};
1829 }
1830 if (expr->kind == ExprKind::Literal) {
1831 return Prop<T>{convert(expr->literal, session.formatting())};
1832 }
1833 return Prop<T>{ui::slot(
1834 nextSlot(), [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr, convert, session = &session]() -> T {
1835 return convert(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr), session->formatting());
1836 })};
1837 }
1838
1839 /// @brief A property read through @p read, as a numbered slot.
1840 template <typename T, typename Read>
1841 Prop<T> slotProp(Read read) {
1842 return Prop<T>{ui::slot(nextSlot(), std::move(read))};
1843 }
1844
1845 /// @brief Evaluates an expression once, untracked: a property the view tree sets once.
1846 [[nodiscard]] Value once(LowerCtx const& ctx, ExprPtr const& expr) const {
1847 return runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), expr); });
1848 }
1849
1850 std::shared_ptr<Document const> _doc;
1851 SlotId _slots = 1;
1852};
1853
1854} // namespace detail
1855
1856/// @brief A mounted screen: its scopes, its view mounted through `Mounted`, and what its host asks of it.
1857///
1858/// Neither copyable nor movable. It belongs to the runtime's owner; the runtime, the session, the dispatcher and
1859/// the backend outlive it. Destroying it runs `onUnmount`, unmounts the view and releases every scope.
1860class Screen {
1861public:
1862 Screen(Screen const&) = delete;
1863 Screen& operator=(Screen const&) = delete;
1864 Screen(Screen&&) = delete;
1865 Screen& operator=(Screen&&) = delete;
1866
1867 /// @brief Runs `onUnmount`, then unmounts.
1868 ~Screen() {
1869 try {
1870 if (Commands const* const commands = lifecycleList("onUnmount")) {
1871 runCommands(*commands);
1872 }
1873 } catch (...) { // NOLINT(bugprone-empty-catch): a destructor has no one to report to.
1874 }
1875 _mounted.reset();
1876 _scope.reset();
1877 }
1878
1879 /// @brief The root widget.
1880 /// @return It, valid as long as the screen.
1881 [[nodiscard]] Widget& root() const {
1882 if (!_mounted) {
1883 throw std::logic_error{"the screen is not mounted"};
1884 }
1885 return _mounted->root();
1886 }
1887
1888 /// @brief The document's id.
1889 /// @return It.
1890 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& id() const noexcept { return _core->doc().id; }
1891
1892 /// @brief Evaluates an expression in the screen's scope: what a host reads (`title`, `identity`), and what a
1893 /// test inspects.
1894 /// @param expression The expression's JSON.
1895 /// @return The value; `null` for an expression that does not parse.
1896 [[nodiscard]] Value read(Json const& expression) const {
1897 auto parsed = parseExpression(expression);
1898 if (!parsed) {
1899 return Value{};
1900 }
1901 return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, *parsed);
1902 }
1903
1904 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `title`.
1905 /// @return It, or `null`.
1906 [[nodiscard]] Value title() const { return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _core->doc().title); }
1907
1908 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `identity`.
1909 /// @return It, or `null`.
1910 [[nodiscard]] Value identity() const { return detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _core->doc().identity); }
1911
1912 /// @brief Evaluates the document's `dirty`.
1913 /// @return Whether it is `true`.
1914 [[nodiscard]] bool dirty() const {
1915 Value const value = detail::evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _core->doc().dirty);
1916 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
1917 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
1918 }
1919
1920 /// @brief Runs `onClose`, as the host does before it closes the screen.
1921 /// @return False when `onClose` ran `cancelClose`: the screen stays open.
1922 bool requestClose() {
1923 Commands const* const commands = lifecycleList("onClose");
1924 if (commands == nullptr) {
1925 return true;
1926 }
1927 return !runCommands(*commands);
1928 }
1929
1930 /// @brief Runs a lifecycle command list: `onSave`, `onBackendChange`, or any other the document declares.
1931 /// @param key The key.
1932 void runLifecycle(std::string_view key) {
1933 if (Commands const* const commands = lifecycleList(key)) {
1934 runCommands(*commands);
1935 }
1936 }
1937
1938 /// @brief The diagnostics reported so far, each path and reason once.
1939 /// @return They.
1940 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Refusal> const& diagnostics() const noexcept { return _core->diagnostics; }
1941
1942 /// @brief Sets the user's choice at a customization point, as the preferences store loaded or the user made
1943 /// it. A choice that does not fit the point is ignored (spec 5 §12b).
1944 /// @param point The point.
1945 /// @param value The choice.
1946 /// @return Whether it fits and was taken.
1947 bool setPreference(std::string const& point, Value value) {
1948 auto const found = _core->doc().customize.find(point);
1949 if (found == _core->doc().customize.end() || !fits(found->second, value)) {
1950 return false;
1951 }
1952 ValueRecord prefs = _core->prefs.peek();
1953 prefs.insert_or_assign(point, std::move(value));
1954 _core->prefs.set(std::move(prefs));
1955 return true;
1956 }
1957
1958 /// @brief What an alias of this screen lends to a screen it opens that borrows it.
1959 /// @param alias The alias.
1960 /// @return Its channel and token; an empty channel when it has none.
1961 [[nodiscard]] BorrowedModel lend(std::string_view alias) const;
1962
1963private:
1964 friend class Interpreter;
1965
1966 Screen() = default;
1967
1968 [[nodiscard]] Commands const* lifecycleList(std::string_view key) const {
1969 auto const found = _core->doc().lifecycle.find(key);
1970 return found == _core->doc().lifecycle.end() ? nullptr : &found->second;
1971 }
1972
1973 /// Runs a command list as the screen's own (not a user's); returns whether it ran `cancelClose`.
1974 bool runCommands(Commands const& commands) {
1975 detail::CommandCtx const ctx{.scope = _scope,
1976 .bindings = std::make_shared<detail::Bindings>(),
1977 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
1978 .boundary = nullptr};
1979 _core->runtime().batch([&] { _core->runList(commands, ctx, {}); });
1980 return *ctx.cancelClose;
1981 }
1982
1983 [[nodiscard]] static bool fits(CustomizePoint const& point, Value const& value) {
1984 if (point.kind == "choice") {
1985 std::string const* const text = value.asString();
1986 return text != nullptr && listed(std::span<std::string const>{point.options}, *text);
1987 }
1988 if (point.kind == "value") {
1989 return point.type.admits(value);
1990 }
1991 return true;
1992 }
1993
1994 [[nodiscard]] static bool listed(std::span<std::string const> options, std::string const& text) {
1995 return std::ranges::find(options, text) != options.end();
1996 }
1997
1998 std::unique_ptr<detail::ScreenCore> _core;
1999 std::shared_ptr<detail::RtScope> _scope;
2000 std::optional<Mounted> _mounted;
2001};
2002
2003/// @brief Mounts UI documents (spec 5): one per client process or window, over a session and a dispatcher.
2004class Interpreter {
2005public:
2006 /// @brief An interpreter.
2007 /// @param session The session the screens share. Borrowed.
2008 /// @param dispatcher Where model calls go. Borrowed.
2009 /// @param options The host and the diagnostic callback.
2010 Interpreter(Session& session MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND, Dispatcher& dispatcher MORPH_LIFETIMEBOUND,
2011 InterpreterOptions options = {})
2012 : _session{&session}, _dispatcher{&dispatcher}, _options{std::move(options)} {}
2013
2014 /// @brief Mounts a screen.
2015 ///
2016 /// The document has loaded (`loadDocument`); what mounting adds is what only the opener knows: the params, and
2017 /// the models a `{"from": alias}` instance borrows. A param that is missing and not optional, a param of the
2018 /// wrong type, a borrowed model the opener did not lend and a document without a view are refused.
2019 /// @param doc The document.
2020 /// @param params The params, by name; names the document does not declare are ignored.
2021 /// @param backend The backend to mount on. Borrowed: it outlives the screen.
2022 /// @param options Where to mount, and the models lent.
2023 /// @return The screen, or the refusal.
2024 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<std::unique_ptr<Screen>, Refusal> mount(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc,
2025 ValueRecord const& params,
2026 IViewBackend& backend,
2027 MountOptions const& options = {});
2028
2029private:
2030 Session* _session;
2031 Dispatcher* _dispatcher;
2032 InterpreterOptions _options;
2033};

2039inline void Session::backendChanged() {
2040 _runtime->batch([this] {
2041 for (auto const& [key, entry] : _entries) {
2042 static_cast<void>(key);
2043 entry->stale = true;
2044 }
2045 std::vector<detail::QueryRuntime*> const mounted = _mounted;
2046 for (detail::QueryRuntime* const query : mounted) {
2047 query->invalidate();
2048 }
2049 });
2050}
2051
2052inline void Session::actionSucceeded(std::string const& typeId, std::string const& actionId) {
2053 std::vector<detail::QueryRuntime*> const mounted = _mounted;
2054 for (detail::QueryRuntime* const query : mounted) {
2055 auto const& names = query->decl().refreshOn;
2056 if (query->typeId() == typeId && std::ranges::find(names, actionId) != names.end()) {
2057 query->invalidate();
2058 }
2059 }
2060}

2066/// @brief The text of an instance key, as the bridge's string-keyed attach takes it.
2067/// @param key The key's value.
2068/// @return The text; empty for `null`.
2069[[nodiscard]] inline std::string instanceKeyText(Value const& key) {
2070 if (key.isNull()) {
2071 return {};
2072 }
2073 if (std::int64_t const* const number = key.asInt()) {
2074 return std::to_string(*number);
2075 }
2076 if (std::string const* const text = key.asString()) {
2077 return *text;
2078 }
2079 return canonicalJson(key);
2080}

2082/// @brief The channel an alias is bound to for its current token, binding it when the token changed.
2083/// @param alias The alias.
2084/// @param core The screen.
2085/// @return The channel, or `nullptr` while the alias is unbound.
2086[[nodiscard]] inline std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> channelOf(ModelAlias& alias, ScreenCore& core) {
2087 std::string const token = core.runtime().untracked([&] { return alias.token->get(); });
2088 if (token.empty()) {
2089 return nullptr;
2090 }
2091 if (alias.channel && alias.boundToken == token) {
2092 return alias.channel;
2093 }
2094 std::string const& type = alias.decl->type;
2095 switch (alias.mode) {
2096 case InstanceMode::Borrowed: {
2097 auto const found = core.borrowed.find(alias.decl->name);
2098 alias.channel = found == core.borrowed.end() ? nullptr : found->second.channel;
2099 break;
2100 }
2101 case InstanceMode::Shared:
2102 alias.channel = core.dispatcher.bind(type, bridge::BindSharing::Shared, {});
2103 break;
2104 case InstanceMode::Keyed:
2105 alias.channel = core.dispatcher.bind(type, bridge::BindSharing::Shared, token.substr(7));
2106 break;
2107 case InstanceMode::Private:
2108 case InstanceMode::Default:
2109 default:
2110 alias.channel = core.dispatcher.bind(type, bridge::BindSharing::Private, {});
2111 break;
2112 }
2113 alias.boundToken = token;
2114 return alias.channel;
2115}

2117inline RtScope::RtScope(ScreenCore& screen, std::shared_ptr<RtScope> enclosing, reactive::Signal<Value> const* current,
2118 std::size_t depth)
2119 : core{screen}, parent{std::move(enclosing)}, row{current}, nodes{screen.runtime(), depth} {}
2120
2121inline RtScope::~RtScope() {
2122 if (owner != nullptr && owner->inner.peek() == this) {
2123 owner->inner.set(nullptr);
2124 }

2127// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): an element's value can read a nested scope's readiness, one level per nesting.
2128inline bool RtScope::ready() const {
2129 for (auto const& element : elements) {
2130 Value const shown = core.elementValue(*element, "visible");
2131 bool const* const visible = shown.asBool();
2132 ValueList const* const errors = element->errors->get().asList();
2133 if ((visible == nullptr || *visible) && errors != nullptr && !errors->empty()) {
2134 return false;
2135 }
2136 }
2137 for (auto const& check : checks) {
2138 if (check->decl->blocking && check->failing->get()) {
2139 return false;
2140 }
2141 }
2142 return true;
2143}
2144
2145inline Value ScopeEnv::ref(std::string_view head, std::span<std::string const> path) const {
2146 if (_bindings != nullptr) {
2147 for (Binding const& bound : std::views::reverse(*_bindings)) {
2148 if (bound.name == head) {
2149 return walk(bound.read(), path);
2150 }
2151 }
2152 }
2153 NameRef const* const name = _scope->find(head);
2154 if (name == nullptr) {
2155 return Value{};
2156 }
2157 switch (name->category) {
2158 case NameCategory::Param:
2159 return walk(name->param, path);
2160 case NameCategory::State:
2161 _scope->core.initState(*name->state->scope, *name->state);
2162 // State inits are acyclic (`loadDocument` checks it), so the value is made by now.
2163 return walk(name->state->value->get(), path);
2164 case NameCategory::Let:
2165 return walk(name->let->get(), path);
2166 case NameCategory::Query:
2167 return walk(name->query->value(), path);
2168 case NameCategory::Element:
2169 if (path.empty()) {
2170 return Value{};
2171 }
2172 return walk(_scope->core.elementValue(*name->element, path.front()), path.subspan(1));
2173 case NameCategory::Transfer: {
2174 if (path.empty()) {
2175 return Value{};
2176 }
2177 TransferState const& transfer = *name->transfer;
2178 Value value;
2179 if (path.front() == "progress") {
2180 value = transfer.progress.get();
2181 } else if (path.front() == "pending") {
2182 value = Value{transfer.pending.get()};
2183 } else if (path.front() == "error") {
2184 value = transfer.error.get();
2185 }
2186 return walk(value, path.subspan(1));
2187 }
2188 case NameCategory::Model:
2189 case NameCategory::Mutation:
2190 default:
2191 return Value{};
2192 }
2193}
2194
2195// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per control form and kind of name.
2196inline Value ScopeEnv::control(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const {
2197 Session const& session = _scope->core.session;
2198 NameRef const* const found = _scope->find(name);
2199 if (form == ExprKind::Can) {
2200 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Query) {
2201 return session.can(found->query->decl().action);
2202 }
2203 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Mutation) {
2204 return session.can(found->mutation->decl().action);
2205 }
2206 return session.can(name);
2207 }
2208 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Query) {
2209 QueryRuntime const& query = *found->query;
2210 if (form == ExprKind::Query) {
2211 return query.value();
2212 }
2213 if (form == ExprKind::Pending) {
2214 return query.pending();
2215 }
2216 if (form == ExprKind::Error) {
2217 return query.error();
2218 }
2219 return form == ExprKind::ErrorKind ? query.errorKind() : Value{};
2220 }
2221 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Mutation) {
2222 MutationRuntime const& mutation = *found->mutation;
2223 if (form == ExprKind::Result) {
2224 return mutation.result();
2225 }
2226 if (form == ExprKind::Pending) {
2227 return mutation.pending();
2228 }
2229 if (form == ExprKind::Error) {
2230 return mutation.error();
2231 }
2232 return form == ExprKind::ErrorKind ? mutation.errorKind() : Value{};
2233 }
2234 return Value{};
2235}
2236
2237inline Value ScopeEnv::pref(std::string_view point, std::span<std::string const> path) const {
2238 ValueRecord const& prefs = _scope->core.prefs.get();
2239 auto const found = prefs.find(point);
2240 return found == prefs.end() ? Value{} : walk(found->second, path);
2241}

2243inline Value ScopeEnv::client(ExprKind form, std::string_view name) const {
