2254
2255inline QueryRuntime::QueryRuntime(QueryDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias)
2256 : _decl{&decl},
2257 _typeId{alias->decl->type},
2258 _scope{&scope},
2259 _alias{alias},
2260 _entry{scope.core.runtime()},
2261 _carried{scope.core.runtime()},
2262 _waiting{scope.core.runtime(), false} {
2263 scope.core.session.attachQuery(*this);
2264}
2265
2266inline QueryRuntime::~QueryRuntime() {
2267 _debounce.cancel();
2268 _refresh.cancel();
2269 _scope->core.session.forgetQuery(*this);
2270 if (auto const& current = _entry.peek()) {
2271 _scope->core.session.release(current);
2272 }
2273}
2274
2275inline std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> QueryRuntime::channel() const { return channelOf(*_alias, _scope->core); }
2276
2277// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): the query's key, its fetch and its refresh triggers.
2278inline void QueryRuntime::start() {
2279 RtScope& scope = *_scope;
2280 auto& key = scope.nodes.computed([this]() -> Target {
2281 Target target;
2282 if (_decl->when) {
2283 Value const when = evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _decl->when);
2284 bool const* const flag = when.asBool();
2285 if (flag == nullptr || !*flag) {
2286 return target;
2287 }
2288 }
2289 std::string token = _alias->token->get();
2290 if (token.empty()) {
2291 return target;
2292 }
2293 Value body = _decl->body ? evalIn(*_scope, nullptr, _decl->body) : Value{ValueRecord{}};
2294 if (body.isNull()) {
2295 return target;
2296 }
2297 target.idle = false;
2298 target.token = std::move(token);
2299 target.bodyText = canonicalJson(body);
2300 target.body = std::move(body);
2301 return target;
2302 });
2303 reactive::Scheduler* const scheduler = scope.core.session.options().scheduler;
2304 std::weak_ptr<bool> const alive = _alive;
2305 scope.nodes.effect([this, &key, scheduler, alive, first = true]() mutable {
2306 Target target = key.get();
2307 _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] {
2308 if (first || target.idle || _decl->debounce <= 0 || scheduler == nullptr) {
2309 first = false;
2310 _debounce.cancel();
2311 _waiting.set(false);
2312 switchTo(target);
2313 return;
2314 }
2315 _pendingTarget = std::move(target);
2316 _waiting.set(true);
2317 _debounce = scheduler->after(std::chrono::milliseconds{_decl->debounce}, [this, alive] {
2318 if (alive.expired()) {
2319 return;
2320 }
2321 _scope->core.runtime().batch([this] {
2322 _waiting.set(false);
2323 switchTo(_pendingTarget);
2324 });
2325 });
2326 });
2327 });
2328 if (_decl->refreshEvery > 0 && scheduler != nullptr) {
2329 _refresh = scheduler->every(std::chrono::milliseconds{_decl->refreshEvery}, [this, alive] {
2330 if (alive.expired()) {
2331 return;
2332 }
2333 auto const current = _entry.peek();
2334 if (!current || _waiting.peek() || current->pending.peek()) {
2335 return;
2336 }
2337 _scope->core.runtime().batch([&] { _scope->core.session.fetch(current, channel()); });
2338 });
2339 }
2340}
2341
2342inline void QueryRuntime::switchTo(Target const& target) {
2343 Session& session = _scope->core.session;
2344 std::shared_ptr<CacheEntry> const old = _entry.peek();
2345 if (old && target == _target) {
2346 return;
2347 }
2348 Value shown = old && old->hasValue.peek() ? old->value.peek() : _carried.peek();
2349 _target = target;
2350 if (target.idle) {
2351 _carried.set(Value{});
2352 _entry.set(nullptr);
2353 if (old) {
2354 session.release(old);
2355 }
2356 return;
2357 }
2358 auto fresh = session.acquire(target.token, _typeId, _decl->action, _decl->evaluate, target.body);
2359 _carried.set(std::move(shown));
2360 _entry.set(fresh);
2361 if (old) {
2362 session.release(old);
2363 }
2364 bool const young = fresh->fetchedAt.has_value() &&
2365 session.now() - *fresh->fetchedAt < std::chrono::milliseconds{_decl->staleTime};
2366 if (!fresh->pending.peek() && (!fresh->hasValue.peek() || fresh->stale || !young)) {
2367 session.fetch(fresh, channel());
2368 }
2369}
2370
2371inline void QueryRuntime::refetch() {
2372 _scope->core.runtime().batch([this] {
2373 bool switched = false;
2374 if (_waiting.peek()) {
2375 _debounce.cancel();
2376 _waiting.set(false);
2377 switchTo(_pendingTarget);
2378 switched = true;
2379 }
2380 auto const current = _entry.peek();
2381 if (current && !(switched && current->pending.peek())) {
2382 _scope->core.session.fetch(current, channel());
2383 }
2384 });
2385}
2386
2387inline Value QueryRuntime::value() const {
2388 auto const& current = _entry.get();
2389 if (current) {
2390 if (current->hasValue.get()) {
2391 return current->value.get();
2392 }
2393 if (!current->error.get().empty()) {
2394 return Value{};
2395 }
2396 }
2397 return _carried.get();
2398}
2399
2400inline bool QueryRuntime::pending() const {
2401 if (_waiting.get()) {
2402 return true;
2403 }
2404 auto const& current = _entry.get();
2405 return current && current->pending.get();
2406}
2407
2408inline Value QueryRuntime::error() const {
2409 auto const& current = _entry.get();
2410 if (!current || current->error.get().empty()) {
2411 return Value{};
2412 }
2413 return Value{current->error.get()};
2414}
2415
2416inline Value QueryRuntime::errorKind() const {
2417 auto const& current = _entry.get();
2418 if (!current || current->errorKind.get().empty()) {
2419 return Value{};
2420 }
2421 return Value{current->errorKind.get()};
2422}
2423
2424inline bool QueryRuntime::settled() const {
2425 auto const& current = _entry.get();
2426 return !current || current->hasValue.get() || !current->error.get().empty();
2427}

2429// --- Mutations -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2430
2431inline MutationRuntime::MutationRuntime(MutationDecl const& decl, RtScope& scope, ModelAlias* alias)
2432 : _decl{&decl},
2433 _scope{&scope},
2434 _alias{alias},
2435 _typeId{alias->decl->type},
2436 _inFlight{scope.core.runtime(), 0},
2437 _result{scope.core.runtime()},
2438 _error{scope.core.runtime()},
2439 _errorKind{scope.core.runtime()} {}
2440
2441// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a mutation's commands can run another mutation, and a serial queue sends its next
2442// run as the last one settles.
2443inline void MutationRuntime::run(Value body, std::shared_ptr<Bindings const> bindings, RunDone done) {
2444 auto run = std::make_shared<Run>();
2445 run->body = std::move(body);
2446 run->bindings = std::move(bindings);
2447 run->done = std::move(done);
2448 if (_decl->concurrency == Concurrency::Exclusive && _inFlight.peek() > 0) {
2449 run->done(false, Value{});
2450 return;
2451 }
2452 _inFlight.set(_inFlight.peek() + 1);
2453 if (_decl->concurrency == Concurrency::Serial) {
2454 Value const key = evalIn(*_scope, run->bindings.get(), _decl->serialKey);
2455 run->serialKey = key.isNull() ? std::string{} : canonicalJson(key);
2456 if (_busy.contains(run->serialKey)) {
2457 _queues[run->serialKey].push_back(run);
2458 return;
2459 }
2460 _busy.insert(run->serialKey);
2461 }
2462 send(run);
2463}
2464
2465inline void MutationRuntime::send(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run) {
2466 run->id = ++_runs;
2467 _latest = run->id;
2468 applyOptimistic(*run);
2469 std::shared_ptr<ModelChannel> const channel = channelOf(*_alias, _scope->core);
2470 if (channel == nullptr) {
2471 settle(run, std::nullopt, std::make_exception_ptr(std::runtime_error{"the model alias has no instance"}));
2472 return;
2473 }
2474 std::weak_ptr<bool> const alive = _alive;
2475 try {
2476 auto completion = channel->execute(_decl->action, canonicalJson(run->body),
2477 CallOptions{.queueOffline = _decl->offlineQueue});
2478 completion
2479 .then([this, alive, run](std::string const& reply) {
2480 if (alive.expired()) {
2481 return;
2482 }
2483 auto json = parseJson(reply);
2484 auto value = json ? valueFromJson(*json) : std::unexpected(json.error());
2485 if (!value) {
2486 settle(run, std::nullopt,
2487 std::make_exception_ptr(
2488 std::runtime_error{"the reply is not a document value: " + value.error()}));
2489 return;
2490 }
2491 settle(run, std::move(*value), nullptr);
2492 })
2493 .onError([this, alive, run](std::exception_ptr const& error) {
2494 if (!alive.expired()) {
2495 settle(run, std::nullopt, error);
2496 }
2497 });
2498 } catch (...) {
2499 settle(run, std::nullopt, std::current_exception());
2500 }
2501}
2502
2503inline void MutationRuntime::applyOptimistic(Run& run) {
2504 if (!_decl->optimistic) {
2505 return;
2506 }
2507 NameRef const* const target = _scope->find(_decl->optimistic->query);
2508 if (target == nullptr || target->category != NameCategory::Query) {
2509 return;
2510 }
2511 auto entry = _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] { return target->query->entry(); });
2512 if (!entry) {
2513 return;
2514 }
2515 Bindings bindings = *run.bindings;
2516 bindings.push_back(Binding{.name = "body", .read = [body = run.body] { return body; }});
2517 Value key = _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*_scope, &bindings, _decl->optimistic->key); });
2518 Value with = _scope->core.runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*_scope, &bindings, _decl->optimistic->with); });
2519 entry->layers.push_back(OptimisticLayer{.run = run.id, .key = std::move(key), .with = std::move(with)});
2520 _scope->core.session.showLayers(*entry);
2521 run.layered.push_back(std::move(entry));
2522}
2523
2524inline void MutationRuntime::dropLayers(Run& run) {
2525 for (auto const& entry : run.layered) {
2526 std::erase_if(entry->layers, [&](OptimisticLayer const& layer) { return layer.run == run.id; });
2527 _scope->core.session.showLayers(*entry);
2528 }
2529 run.layered.clear();
2530}
2531
2532// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one branch per outcome a reply can have.
2533inline void MutationRuntime::settle(std::shared_ptr<Run> const& run, std::optional<Value> reply,
2534 std::exception_ptr const& error) {
2535 ScreenCore& core = _scope->core;
2536 Session& session = core.session;
2537 bool const applied = _decl->concurrency != Concurrency::Latest || run->id == _latest;
2538 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> const scope = _scope->shared_from_this();
2539 auto commandCtx = [&](Bindings extra) {
2540 return CommandCtx{.scope = scope,
2541 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(std::move(extra)),
2542 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
2543 .boundary = nullptr};
2544 };
2545 Value delivered;
2546 bool succeeded = false;
2547 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one branch per outcome a reply can have.
2548 core.runtime().batch([&] {
2549 _inFlight.set(_inFlight.peek() - 1);
2550 if (reply) {
2551 succeeded = true;
2552 // The run's optimistic writes are confirmed by the reply: they become part of the confirmed rows.
2553 for (auto const& entry : run->layered) {
2554 Value confirmed = entry->confirmed;
2555 for (OptimisticLayer const& layer : entry->layers) {
2556 if (layer.run == run->id) {
2557 if (auto patched = patchRows(confirmed, layer.key, layer.with)) {
2558 confirmed = std::move(*patched);
2559 }
2560 }
2561 }
2562 std::erase_if(entry->layers, [&](OptimisticLayer const& layer) { return layer.run == run->id; });
2563 session.confirm(*entry, confirmed);
2564 }
2565 run->layered.clear();
2566 std::vector<std::string> secret;
2567 if (session.options().catalog.action) {
2568 if (auto const info = session.options().catalog.action(_decl->action)) {
2569 secret = info->secretFields;
2570 }
2571 }
2572 delivered = withoutFields(*reply, secret);
2573 if (!applied) {
2574 return;
2575 }
2576 _result.set(*reply);
2577 _error.set(Value{});
2578 _errorKind.set(Value{});
2579 if (_decl->patch) {
2580 Bindings bindings = *run->bindings;
2581 bindings.push_back(Binding{.name = "result", .read = [value = *reply] { return value; }});
2582 NameRef const* const target = _scope->find(_decl->patch->query);
2583 if (target != nullptr && target->category == NameCategory::Query) {
2584 auto entry = core.runtime().untracked([&] { return target->query->entry(); });
2585 Value const key =
2586 core.runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*_scope, &bindings, _decl->patch->key); });
2587 Value const with =
2588 core.runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*_scope, &bindings, _decl->patch->with); });
2589 if (entry) {
2590 if (auto patched = patchRows(entry->confirmed, key, with)) {
2591 session.confirm(*entry, *patched);
2592 }
2593 }
2594 }
2595 }
2596 for (std::string const& name : _decl->invalidates) {
2597 NameRef const* const target = _scope->find(name);
2598 if (target != nullptr && target->category == NameCategory::Query) {
2599 target->query->invalidate();
2600 }
2601 }
2602 session.actionSucceeded(_typeId, _decl->action);
2603 core.runList(_decl->onSuccess, commandCtx(*run->bindings), {});
2604 if (!secret.empty()) {
2605 _result.set(delivered);
2606 }
2607 return;
2608 }
2609 dropLayers(*run);
2610 std::string const kind = session.classify(error);
2611 if (applied) {
2612 _error.set(Value{failureText(error)});
2613 _errorKind.set(Value{kind});
2614 core.runList(_decl->onError, commandCtx(*run->bindings), {});
2615 }
2616 if (kind == "denied" && core.host != nullptr) {
2617 core.host->permissionsStale();
2618 }
2619 });
2620 if (_decl->concurrency == Concurrency::Serial) {
2621 next(run->serialKey);
2622 }
2623 run->done(succeeded, delivered);
2624}
2625
2626inline void MutationRuntime::next(std::string const& serialKey) {
2627 auto const found = _queues.find(serialKey);
2628 if (found == _queues.end() || found->second.empty()) {
2629 _queues.erase(serialKey);
2630 _busy.erase(serialKey);
2631 return;
2632 }
2633 std::shared_ptr<Run> const queued = found->second.front();
2634 found->second.pop_front();
2635 _scope->core.runtime().batch([&] { send(queued); });
2636}
2637// NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)

2645/// @brief The element a node of a scope keeps its state in.
2646/// @param scope The scope that declares it.
2647/// @param node The node.
2648/// @return The element, or `nullptr` for a node that keeps none.
2649[[nodiscard]] inline ElementState* elementFor(RtScope const& scope, DocNode const& node) {
2650 for (auto const& element : scope.elements) {
2651 if (element->node == &node) {
2652 return element.get();
2653 }
2654 }
2655 return nullptr;
2656}

2658/// @brief The transfers of the `upload` commands in a list, nested lists included.
2659/// @param commands The list.
2660/// @param out Where the transfer ids go.
2661// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): one level per nested command list
2662inline void transfersOf(Commands const& commands, std::vector<std::string>& out) {
2663 for (Command const& command : commands) {
2664 if (command.kind == CommandKind::Upload && !command.transfer.empty()) {
2665 out.push_back(command.transfer);
2666 }
2667 transfersOf(command.commands, out);
2668 transfersOf(command.alternative, out);
2669 }
2670}

2672// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a document is a tree of nodes and parts, and collecting descends it.
2673// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of node and part.
2674inline void ScreenCore::collect(DocNode const& node, RtScope& scope, std::vector<Commands const*>& commands) {
2675 KindSpec const* const spec = findKind(node.kind, false);
2676 if (!node.id.empty() || statefulKind(node.kind)) {
2677 auto element = std::make_unique<ElementState>(runtime());
2678 element->node = &node;
2679 element->scope = &scope;
2680 if (!node.id.empty()) {
2681 NameRef name;
2682 name.category = NameCategory::Element;
2683 name.element = element.get();
2684 scope.names.insert_or_assign(node.id, name);
2685 }
2686 wireErrors(*element);
2687 scope.elements.push_back(std::move(element));
2688 }
2689 bool const createsScope = spec != nullptr && (spec->flags & kScope) != 0;
2690 for (auto const& [key, list] : node.events) {
2691 KeySpec const* const keyed = spec == nullptr ? nullptr : keySpec(*spec, key);
2692 if (!createsScope || keyed == nullptr || (keyed->flags & kInner) == 0) {
2693 commands.push_back(&list);
2694 }
2695 }
2696 for (auto const& [chord, list] : node.keys) {
2697 static_cast<void>(chord);
2698 commands.push_back(&list);
2699 }
2700 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : node.children) {
2701 KeySpec const* const keyed = spec == nullptr ? nullptr : keySpec(*spec, key);
2702 if (createsScope && keyed != nullptr && (keyed->flags & kInner) != 0) {
2703 continue;
2704 }
2705 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
2706 collect(*child, scope, commands);
2707 }
2708 }
2709 for (auto const& [key, parts] : node.parts) {
2710 static_cast<void>(key);
2711 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
2712 KindSpec const* const partSpec = findKind(part->kind, true);
2713 if (partSpec != nullptr && (partSpec->flags & kScope) != 0) {
2714 continue;
2715 }
2716 for (auto const& [event, list] : part->events) {
2717 static_cast<void>(event);
2718 commands.push_back(&list);
2719 }
2720 for (auto const& [childKey, nodes] : part->children) {
2721 KeySpec const* const keyed = partSpec == nullptr ? nullptr : keySpec(*partSpec, childKey);
2722 if (keyed != nullptr && (keyed->flags & kInner) != 0) {
2723 continue;
2724 }
2725 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
2726 collect(*child, scope, commands);
2727 }
2728 }
2729 }
2730 }
2731}
2732// NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)
2733
2734// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one section per kind of declaration.
2735inline void ScreenCore::declare(RtScope& scope, ScopeDecl const* decl, std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content,
2736 std::vector<Commands const*> const& commands) {
2737 std::vector<Commands const*> lists = commands;
2738 for (DocNode const* const node : content) {
2739 collect(*node, scope, lists);
2740 }
2741 std::vector<std::string> transferIds;
2742 for (Commands const* const list : lists) {
2743 transfersOf(*list, transferIds);
2744 }
2745 for (std::string const& transferId : transferIds) {
2746 if (scope.names.contains(transferId)) {
2747 continue;
2748 }
2749 scope.transfers.push_back(std::make_unique<TransferState>(runtime()));
2750 NameRef name;
2751 name.category = NameCategory::Transfer;
2752 name.transfer = scope.transfers.back().get();
2753 scope.names.insert_or_assign(transferId, name);
2754 }
2755 if (decl != nullptr) {
2756 for (ModelDecl const& model : decl->models) {
2757 auto alias = std::make_unique<ModelAlias>();
2758 alias->decl = &model;
2759 alias->mode = model.instance;
2760 if (alias->mode == InstanceMode::Default) {
2761 std::optional<ModelInfo> const info =
2762 session.options().catalog.model ? session.options().catalog.model(model.type) : std::nullopt;
2763 alias->mode = info && info->stateless ? InstanceMode::Shared : InstanceMode::Private;
2764 }
2765 ModelAlias* const raw = alias.get();
2766 switch (raw->mode) {
2767 case InstanceMode::Keyed:
2768 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, raw]() -> std::string {
2769 std::string const key = instanceKeyText(evalIn(scope, nullptr, raw->decl->key));
2770 return key.empty() ? std::string{} : "shared:" + key;
2771 });
2772 break;
2773 case InstanceMode::Shared:
2774 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([] { return std::string{"shared"}; });
2775 break;
2776 case InstanceMode::Borrowed: {
2777 auto const found = borrowed.find(model.name);
2778 std::string token = found == borrowed.end() ? std::string{} : found->second.token;
2779 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([token = std::move(token)] { return token; });
2780 break;
2781 }
2782 case InstanceMode::Private:
2783 case InstanceMode::Default:
2784 default: {
2785 std::string token = session.privateToken();
2786 raw->token = &scope.nodes.computed([token = std::move(token)] { return token; });
2787 break;
2788 }
2789 }
2790 NameRef name;
2791 name.category = NameCategory::Model;
2792 name.model = raw;
2793 scope.names.insert_or_assign(model.name, name);
2794 scope.models.push_back(std::move(alias));
2795 }
2796 for (LetDecl const& let : decl->lets) {
2797 NameRef name;
2798 name.category = NameCategory::Let;
2799 name.letExpr = let.value;
2800 name.let = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = let.value] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
2801 scope.names.insert_or_assign(let.name, name);
2802 }
2803 for (StateDecl const& state : decl->state) {
2804 auto slot = std::make_unique<StateSlot>();
2805 slot->decl = &state;
2806 slot->scope = &scope;
2807 NameRef name;
2808 name.category = NameCategory::State;
2809 name.state = slot.get();
2810 scope.names.insert_or_assign(state.name, name);
2811 scope.states.push_back(std::move(slot));
2812 }
2813 auto aliasOf = [&scope](std::string const& model) -> ModelAlias* {
2814 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(model);
2815 return found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Model ? found->model : nullptr;
2816 };
2817 for (QueryDecl const& query : decl->queries) {
2818 scope.queries.push_back(std::make_unique<QueryRuntime>(query, scope, aliasOf(query.model)));
2819 NameRef name;
2820 name.category = NameCategory::Query;
2821 name.query = scope.queries.back().get();
2822 scope.names.insert_or_assign(query.name, name);
2823 }
2824 for (MutationDecl const& mutation : decl->mutations) {
2825 scope.mutations.push_back(std::make_unique<MutationRuntime>(mutation, scope, aliasOf(mutation.model)));
2826 NameRef name;
2827 name.category = NameCategory::Mutation;
2828 name.mutation = scope.mutations.back().get();
2829 scope.names.insert_or_assign(mutation.name, name);
2830 }
2831 }
2832 for (auto const& slot : scope.states) {
2833 initState(scope, *slot);
2834 }
2835 for (auto const& element : scope.elements) {
2836 wireElement(*element);
2837 }
2838 if (decl == nullptr) {
2839 return;
2840 }
2841 for (CheckDecl const& check : decl->checks) {
2842 auto made = std::make_unique<CheckRuntime>();
2843 made->decl = &check;
2844 made->failing = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = check.assertion] {
2845 Value const asserted = evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr);
2846 bool const* const flag = asserted.asBool();
2847 return flag != nullptr && !*flag;
2848 });
2849 made->message = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = check.message, session = &session] {
2850 return textOf(evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr), session->formatting());
2851 });
2852 for (std::string const& target : check.targets) {
2853 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(target);
2854 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Element) {
2855 found->element->checks.push_back(made.get());
2856 made->targets.push_back(found->element);
2857 found->element->checksVersion.set(found->element->checksVersion.peek() + 1);
2858 }
2859 }
2860 scope.checks.push_back(std::move(made));
2861 }
2862 for (auto const& query : scope.queries) {
2863 query->start();
2864 }
2865 for (WatchDecl const& watch : decl->watches) {
2866 auto& source = scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = watch.on] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
2867 scope.nodes.effect([this, &scope, &source, watched = &watch, first = true]() mutable {
2868 static_cast<void>(source.get());
2869 if (first) {
2870 first = false;
2871 return;
2872 }
2873 bool const user = session.lastWriteByUser();
2874 if (watched->source == WatchSource::User && !user) {
2875 return;
2876 }
2877 runtime().untracked([&] {
2878 CommandCtx const ctx{.scope = scope.shared_from_this(),
2879 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(),
2880 .cancelClose = std::make_shared<bool>(false),
2881 .boundary = nullptr};
2882 if (user) {
2883 session.asUser([&] { runList(watched->body, ctx, {}); });
2884 } else {
2885 runList(watched->body, ctx, {});
2886 }
2887 });
2888 });
2889 }
2890}
2891
2892/// @brief Whether two values show the same in an input: by text for a text input, by value otherwise.
2893/// @param kind The input's kind.
2894/// @param lhs One value.
2895/// @param rhs The other.
2896/// @param format The formatting facts.
2897/// @return It.
2898[[nodiscard]] inline bool sameShown(std::string_view kind, Value const& lhs, Value const& rhs,
2899 FormatContext const& format) {
2900 if (kind == "textInput" || kind == "filePicker") {
2901 return textOf(lhs, format) == textOf(rhs, format);
2902 }
2903 return lhs == rhs;
2904}
2905
2906/// @brief The key of a select option: a record's `key`, `id` or `value` field, or the option itself.
2907/// @param option The option.
2908/// @return The key.
2909[[nodiscard]] inline Value optionKey(Value const& option) {
2910 if (option.asRecord() == nullptr) {
2911 return option;
2912 }
2913 for (std::string_view const field : {"key", "id", "value"}) {
2914 if (Value const* const found = option.field(field)) {
2915 return *found;
2916 }
2917 }
2918 return Value{};
2919}

2921// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one rule per source of an error.
2922inline void ScreenCore::wireErrors(ElementState& element) {
2923 RtScope& scope = *element.scope;
2924 element.errors = &scope.nodes.computed([this, &element]() -> Value {
2925 static_cast<void>(element.checksVersion.get());
2926 DocNode const& field = *element.node;
2927 RtScope const& owner = *element.scope;
2928 std::vector<std::string> errors;
2929 if (ExprPtr const required = field.prop("required")) {
2930 Value const requiredNow = evalIn(owner, nullptr, required);
2931 bool const* const flag = requiredNow.asBool();
2932 if (flag != nullptr && *flag && !engaged(inputValue(element))) {
2933 errors.emplace_back("Required");
2934 }
2935 }
2936 for (std::string& text : stringsOf(evalIn(owner, nullptr, field.prop("errors")))) {
2937 errors.push_back(std::move(text));
2938 }
2939 if (!field.id.empty()) {
2940 std::vector<std::string> const path{"errors", field.id};
2941 for (auto const& query : owner.queries) {
2942 for (std::string& text : stringsOf(walk(query->value(), path))) {
2943 errors.push_back(std::move(text));
2944 }
2945 }
2946 for (auto const& mutation : owner.mutations) {
2947 for (std::string& text : stringsOf(walk(mutation->result(), path))) {
2948 errors.push_back(std::move(text));
2949 }
2950 }
2951 }
2952 for (CheckRuntime const* const check : element.checks) {
2953 if (check->failing->get()) {
2954 errors.push_back(check->message->get());
2955 }
2956 }
2957 return listOfStrings(errors);
2958 });
2959}
2960
2961// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of element.
2962inline void ScreenCore::wireElement(ElementState& element) {
2963 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
2964 RtScope& scope = *element.scope;
2965 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
2966 bool const input = kind == "textInput" || kind == "checkbox" || kind == "select" || kind == "dateTimeInput" ||
2967 kind == "slider" || kind == "filePicker";
2968 if (input) {
2969 std::string_view key = "value";
2970 if (kind == "checkbox") {
2971 key = "checked";
2972 } else if (kind == "select") {
2973 key = "selected";
2974 }
2975 ExprPtr const expr = kind == "filePicker" ? nullptr : node.prop(key);
2976 bool const controlled = expr && (expr->kind != ExprKind::Literal || !expr->literal.isNull());
2977 if (controlled) {
2978 element.bound = &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
2979 element.draft.set(runtime().untracked([&] { return element.bound->get(); }));
2980 scope.nodes.effect([this, &element, kind] {
2981 Value const bound = element.bound->get();
2982 runtime().untracked([&] {
2983 if (!element.edited.peek()) {
2984 element.draft.set(bound);
2985 } else if (sameShown(kind, element.draft.peek(), bound, session.formatting())) {
2986 element.edited.set(false);
2987 }
2988 });
2989 });
2990 } else if (kind == "checkbox") {
2991 element.draft.set(false);
2992 }
2993 }
2994 if (kind == "select") {
2995 element.rows =
2996 &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = node.prop("options")] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
2997 if (element.bound == nullptr && node.name("onStale") == "clear") {
2998 scope.nodes.effect([this, &element] {
2999 Value const options = element.rows->get();
3000 runtime().untracked([&] {
3001 Value const selected = element.draft.peek();
3002 if (selected.isNull()) {
3003 return;
3004 }
3005 ValueList const* const items = options.asList();
3006 bool const kept = items != nullptr && std::ranges::any_of(*items, [&](Value const& option) {
3007 return optionKey(option) == selected;
3008 });
3009 if (!kept) {
3010 session.noteWrite();
3011 element.draft.set(Value{});
3012 }
3013 });
3014 });
3015 }
3016 }
3017 if (kind == "table" && node.prop("rows")) {
3018 element.rows =
3019 &scope.nodes.computed([&scope, expr = node.prop("rows")] { return evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr); });
3020 }
3021}

3023inline Value ScreenCore::inputValue(ElementState const& element) const {
3024 std::string_view const kind = element.node->kind;
3025 if (kind == "checkbox") {
3026 return elementValue(element, "checked");
3027 }
3028 if (kind == "select") {
3029 return elementValue(element, "selected");
3030 }
3031 return elementValue(element, "value");
3032}
3033
3034// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion,readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per element value.
3035inline Value ScreenCore::elementValue(ElementState const& element, std::string_view name) const {
3036 DocNode const& node = *element.node;
3037 RtScope const& scope = *element.scope;
3038 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
3039 auto flagOf = [&](std::string_view key, bool fallback) -> Value {
3040 ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key);
3041 if (!expr) {
3042 return fallback;
3043 }
3044 Value const value = evalIn(scope, nullptr, expr);
3045 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
3046 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
3047 };
3048 auto errors = [&]() -> Value { return element.errors->get(); };
3049 auto count = [](Value const& list) -> Value {
3050 ValueList const* const items = list.asList();
3051 return static_cast<std::int64_t>(items == nullptr ? 0 : items->size());
3052 };
3053 if (name == "visible" || name == "enabled") {
3054 return flagOf(name, true);
3055 }
3056 if (name == "errors") {
3057 return errors();
3058 }
3059 if (name == "valid") {
3060 Value const current = errors();
3061 ValueList const* const items = current.asList();
3062 return items == nullptr || items->empty();
3063 }
3064 if (name == "shownErrors") {
3065 RtScope const& policy = scope.policyScope();
3066 std::string const mode = policy.showErrors.empty() ? _doc->showErrors : policy.showErrors;
3067 bool const submittedNow = policy.submitted != nullptr && policy.submitted->get();
3068 if (mode == "always" || (mode == "submit" && submittedNow) ||
3069 (mode != "submit" && (submittedNow || element.touched.get()))) {
3070 return errors();
3071 }
3072 return Value{ValueList{}};
3073 }
3074 if (kind == "dialog" || kind == "drawer") {
3075 if (name == "open") {
3076 return node.prop("open") ? flagOf("open", false) : Value{element.open.get()};
3077 }
3078 if (name == "ready") {
3079 RtScope const* const inner = element.inner.get();
3080 return inner != nullptr && inner->ready();
3081 }
3082 if (name == "submitted") {
3083 return element.submitted.get();
3084 }
3085 return Value{};
3086 }
3087 if (kind == "table") {
3088 if (name == "selection") {
3089 return element.selection.get();
3090 }
3091 if (name == "activeKey") {
3092 return element.activeKey.get();
3093 }
3094 if (name == "selectedCount") {
3095 return count(element.selection.get());
3096 }
3097 if (name == "viewCount" || name == "sourceCount") {
3098 return element.rows == nullptr ? Value{std::int64_t{0}} : count(element.rows->get());
3099 }
3100 ExprPtr const rows = node.prop("rows");
3101 if ((name == "pending" || name == "error") && rows && rows->kind == ExprKind::Query) {
3102 ScopeEnv const env{scope, nullptr};
3103 return env.control(name == "pending" ? ExprKind::Pending : ExprKind::Error, rows->name);
3104 }
3105 return name == "pending" ? Value{false} : Value{};
3106 }
3107 if (name == "draft") {
3108 return element.draft.get();
3109 }
3110 if (name == "dirty") {
3111 return element.edited.get();
3112 }
3113 if (name == "focused") {
3114 return element.focused.get();
3115 }
3116 if (name == "touched") {
3117 return element.touched.get();
3118 }
3119 if (name == "checked" || name == "selected") {
3120 return element.bound != nullptr ? element.bound->get() : element.draft.get();
3121 }
3122 if (name == "selectedOption") {
3123 Value const selected = elementValue(element, "selected");
3124 ValueList const* const options = element.rows == nullptr ? nullptr : element.rows->get().asList();
3125 if (options != nullptr && !selected.isNull()) {
3126 for (Value const& option : *options) {
3127 if (optionKey(option) == selected) {
3128 return option;
3129 }
3130 }
3131 }
3132 return Value{};
3133 }
3134 if (name == "value") {
3135 if (element.bound != nullptr) {
3136 return element.bound->get();
3137 }
3138 return element.committed.get();
3139 }
3140 return Value{};
3141}
3142
3143// --- Commands --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3144
3145// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): command lists nest
3146inline void ScreenCore::runList(Commands const& commands, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) {
3147 if (!done) {
3148 done = [](bool) {};
3149 }
3150 if (commands.empty()) {
3151 done(true);
3152 return;
3153 }
3154 struct Join {
3155 std::size_t left = 0;
3156 bool ok = true;
3157 Done done;
3158 };
3159 auto join = std::make_shared<Join>(Join{.left = commands.size() + 1, .ok = true, .done = std::move(done)});
3160 auto finish = [join](bool succeeded) {
3161 join->ok = join->ok && succeeded;
3162 if (--join->left == 0) {
3163 join->done(join->ok);
3164 }
3165 };
3166 for (Command const& command : commands) {
3167 runOne(command, ctx, finish);
3168 }
3169 finish(true);
3170}
3171
3172// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per command of ui/1.
3173inline void ScreenCore::runOne(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) {
3174 if (!done) {
3175 done = [](bool) {};
3176 }
3177 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
3178 auto eval = [&](ExprPtr const& expr) { return evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), expr); };
3179 auto finish = [&done](bool succeeded) { done(succeeded); };
3180 switch (command.kind) {
3181 case CommandKind::Set:
3182 runSet(command, ctx, done);
3183 return;
3184 case CommandKind::Reset:
3185 runReset(command, ctx, done);
3186 return;
3187 case CommandKind::Run:
3188 runMutation(command, ctx, std::move(done));
3189 return;
3190 case CommandKind::Refetch: {
3191 // A loaded document's `refetch` names a query in scope (`loadDocument` checks it), as `run` names a
3192 // mutation and `open` a dialog.
3193 scope.find(command.target)->query->refetch();
3194 finish(true);
3195 return;
3196 }
3197 case CommandKind::Open:
3198 case CommandKind::Close: {
3199 if (command.kind == CommandKind::Close && command.target == "self") {
3200 finish((host != nullptr && host->closeSelf(_doc->id, std::nullopt)) ||
3201 unsupported(command, "`close: self`"));
3202 return;
3203 }
3204 ElementState& element = *scope.find(command.target)->element;
3205 if (element.node->prop("open")) {
3206 report(command.path, "the dialog's `open` is bound to an expression");
3207 finish(false);
3208 return;
3209 }
3210 bool const opening = command.kind == CommandKind::Open;
3211 if (opening && !element.open.peek()) {
3212 element.submitted.set(false);
3213 }
3214 session.noteWrite();
3215 element.open.set(opening);
3216 finish(true);
3217 return;
3218 }
3219 case CommandKind::Navigate: {
3220 NavigateRequest const request{.screen = command.target,
3221 .route = eval(command.extra),
3222 .params = eval(command.value),
3223 .as = command.option};
3224 if (host == nullptr) {
3225 finish(unsupported(command, "`navigate`"));
3226 return;
3227 }
3228 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
3229 CommandCtx const kept = detached(ctx);
3230 auto onResult = [this, weak, kept, list = &command.commands](Value const& result) {
3231 if (auto const held = weak.lock()) {
3232 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*kept.bindings);
3233 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = "event", .read = [result] { return result; }});
3234 CommandCtx const next{.scope = held,
3235 .bindings = bindings,
3236 .cancelClose = kept.cancelClose,
3237 .boundary = kept.boundary};
3238 runtime().batch([&] { runList(*list, next, {}); });
3239 }
3240 };
3241 auto onCancel = [this, weak, kept, list = &command.alternative] {
3242 if (auto const held = weak.lock()) {
3243 CommandCtx next = kept;
3244 next.scope = held;
3245 runtime().batch([&] { runList(*list, next, {}); });
3246 }
3247 };
3248 finish(host->navigate(request, std::move(onResult), std::move(onCancel)) ||
3249 unsupported(command, "`navigate`"));
3250 return;
3251 }
3252 case CommandKind::Return:
3253 finish(host != nullptr && host->closeSelf(_doc->id, eval(command.value))
3254 ? true
3255 : unsupported(command, "`return`"));
3256 return;
3257 case CommandKind::Focus:
3258 finish(host != nullptr && host->focus(_doc->id, command.target) ? true : unsupported(command, "`focus`"));
3259 return;
3260 case CommandKind::Host:
3261 runHostCommand(command, ctx, done);
3262 return;
3263 case CommandKind::SwitchBackend:
3264 if (host != nullptr && host->switchBackend(command.target)) {
3265 session.backendChanged();
3266 finish(true);
3267 return;
3268 }
3269 report(command.path, "backend `" + command.target + "` is not listed");
3270 finish(false);
3271 return;
3272 case CommandKind::ResetPrefs: {
3273 ValueRecord prefsNow = prefs.peek();
3274 if (command.target == "all") {
3275 prefsNow = prefDefaults;
3276 } else if (auto const found = prefDefaults.find(command.target); found != prefDefaults.end()) {
3277 prefsNow.insert_or_assign(command.target, found->second);
3278 }
3279 prefs.set(std::move(prefsNow));
3280 if (host != nullptr) {
3281 host->resetPrefs(_doc->id, command.target);
3282 }
3283 finish(true);
3284 return;
3285 }
3286 case CommandKind::SetLocale:
3287 session.setLocale(command.target);
3288 if (host != nullptr) {
3289 host->setLocale(command.target);
3290 }
3291 finish(true);
3292 return;
3293 case CommandKind::Notify: {
3294 std::string const text = textOf(eval(command.value), session.formatting());
3295 finish(host != nullptr && host->notify(text, command.option) ? true : unsupported(command, "`notify`"));
3296 return;
3297 }
3298 case CommandKind::Seq: {
3299 // A step that waits for a reply keeps the rest of the sequence in that reply's handler, which the
3300 // dispatcher may hold past the screen: the sequence holds its scope weakly and stops once it is gone.
3301 CommandCtx const inner = detached(CommandCtx{.scope = nullptr,
3302 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings),
3303 .cancelClose = ctx.cancelClose,
3304 .boundary = ctx.boundary});
3305 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
3306 auto step = std::make_shared<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>();
3307 *step = [this, inner, weak, list = &command.commands, done = std::move(done),
3308 weakStep = std::weak_ptr<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>{step}](std::size_t index) {
3309 auto const held = weak.lock();
3310 if (index == list->size() || !held) {
3311 done(held != nullptr);
3312 return;
3313 }
3314 auto const self = weakStep.lock();
3315 CommandCtx current = inner;
3316 current.scope = held;
3317 runOne(list->at(index), current, [self, index, done](bool succeeded) {
3318 if (!succeeded) {
3319 done(false);
3320 return;
3321 }
3322 (*self)(index + 1);
3323 });
3324 };
3325 (*step)(0);
3326 return;
3327 }
3328 case CommandKind::All: {
3329 CommandCtx const inner{.scope = ctx.scope,
3330 .bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings),
3331 .cancelClose = ctx.cancelClose,
3332 .boundary = ctx.boundary};
3333 runList(command.commands, inner, std::move(done));
3334 return;
3335 }
3336 case CommandKind::If: {
3337 Value const condition = eval(command.value);
3338 bool const* const flag = condition.asBool();
3339 if (flag == nullptr) {
3340 finish(true);
3341 return;
3342 }
3343 runList(*flag ? command.commands : command.alternative, ctx, std::move(done));
3344 return;
3345 }
3346 case CommandKind::CancelClose:
3347 *ctx.cancelClose = true;
3348 finish(true);
3349 return;
3350 case CommandKind::Retry:
3351 // `retry` is valid only inside a boundary's `error`, which is lowered with its boundary.
3352 for (QueryRuntime* const query : ctx.boundary->queries) {
3353 if (!runtime().untracked([&] { return query->error(); }).isNull()) {
3354 query->refetch();
3355 }
3356 }
3357 finish(true);
3358 return;
3359 case CommandKind::SignIn: {
3360 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(command.target);
3361 Value const reply = found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Mutation
3362 ? runtime().untracked([&] { return found->mutation->result(); })
3363 : Value{};
3364 session.clear();
3365 finish(host != nullptr && host->signIn(reply) ? true : unsupported(command, "`signIn`"));
3366 return;
3367 }
3368 case CommandKind::SignOut:
3369 session.clear();
3370 if (host != nullptr) {
3371 host->signOut();
3372 }
3373 finish(true);
3374 return;
3375 case CommandKind::Upload:
3376 case CommandKind::Download:
3377 default:
3378 runTransfer(command, ctx, std::move(done));
3379 return;
3380 }
3381}
3382
3383// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a single run, or a run per list item.
3384inline void ScreenCore::runMutation(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) const {
3385 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
3386 MutationRuntime& mutation = *scope.find(command.target)->mutation;
3387 RtScope const& policy = scope.policyScope();
3388 if (policy.submitted != nullptr) {
3389 policy.submitted->set(true);
3390 }
3391 if (policy.owner != nullptr && !runtime().untracked([&] { return policy.ready(); })) {
3392 done(false);
3393 return;
3394 }
3395 RtScope const& declaring = *[&]() -> RtScope const* {
3396 for (RtScope const* candidate = &scope; candidate != nullptr; candidate = candidate->parent.get()) {
3397 if (candidate->names.contains(command.target)) {
3398 return candidate;
3399 }
3400 }
3401 return &scope;
3402 }();
3403 auto bodyFor = [&](Bindings const& bindings) {
3404 if (command.value) {
3405 return evalIn(scope, &bindings, command.value);
3406 }
3407 if (mutation.decl().body) {
3408 return evalIn(declaring, &bindings, mutation.decl().body);
3409 }
3410 return Value{ValueRecord{}};
3411 };
3412 if (!command.extra) {
3413 Value body = bodyFor(*ctx.bindings);
3414 mutation.run(std::move(body), std::make_shared<Bindings const>(*ctx.bindings),
3415 [bindings = ctx.bindings, bindAs = command.binding, done = std::move(done)](bool succeeded,
3416 Value const& reply) {
3417 if (succeeded && !bindAs.empty()) {
3418 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = bindAs, .read = [reply] { return reply; }});
3419 }
3420 done(succeeded);
3421 });
3422 return;
3423 }
3424 Value const each = evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.extra);
3425 ValueList const items = each.asList() == nullptr ? ValueList{} : *each.asList();
3426 if (items.empty()) {
3427 done(true);
3428 return;
3429 }
3430 struct Each {
3431 std::size_t left = 0;
3432 bool ok = true;
3433 Done done;
3434 };
3435 auto state = std::make_shared<Each>(Each{.left = items.size(), .ok = true, .done = std::move(done)});
3436 std::vector<Value> bodies;
3437 std::vector<std::shared_ptr<Bindings const>> bound;
3438 for (Value const& item : items) {
3439 Bindings bindings = *ctx.bindings;
3440 if (!command.binding.empty()) {
3441 bindings.push_back(Binding{.name = command.binding, .read = [item] { return item; }});
3442 }
3443 bodies.push_back(bodyFor(bindings));
3444 bound.push_back(std::make_shared<Bindings const>(std::move(bindings)));
3445 }
3446 if (mutation.decl().concurrency != Concurrency::Exclusive) {
3447 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < bodies.size(); ++index) {
3448 mutation.run(bodies.at(index), bound.at(index), [state](bool succeeded, Value const&) {
3449 state->ok = state->ok && succeeded;
3450 if (--state->left == 0) {
3451 state->done(state->ok);
3452 }
3453 });
3454 }
3455 return;
3456 }
3457 // An exclusive mutation refuses a run while another is in flight, so its elements go one after another.
3458 auto step = std::make_shared<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>();
3459 *step = [&mutation, bodies, bound, state,
3460 weakStep = std::weak_ptr<std::function<void(std::size_t)>>{step}](std::size_t index) {
3461 if (index == bodies.size()) {
3462 state->done(state->ok);
3463 return;
3464 }
3465 auto const self = weakStep.lock();
3466 mutation.run(bodies.at(index), bound.at(index), [self, state, index](bool succeeded, Value const&) {
3467 if (!succeeded) {
3468 state->done(false);
3469 return;
3470 }
3471 (*self)(index + 1);
3472 });
3473 };
3474 (*step)(0);
3475}
3476
3477// NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)
3478inline void ScreenCore::runSet(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done) {
3479 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
3480 auto finish = [&done](bool succeeded) { done(succeeded); };
3481 auto path = splitPath(command.target);
3482 if (!path || path->empty()) {
3483 finish(false);
3484 return;
3485 }
3486 std::string const head = path->front();
3487 std::span<std::string const> const rest = std::span<std::string const>{*path}.subspan(1);
3488 Value value = evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.value);
3489 if (head == "app") {
3490 std::string name;
3491 for (std::string const& segment : rest) {
3492 name += name.empty() ? segment : "." + segment;
3493 }
3494 finish(host != nullptr && host->setAppValue(name, value) ? true : unsupported(command, "`set` of `app`"));
3495 return;
3496 }
3497 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(head);
3498 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::State) {
3499 StateSlot& slot = *found->state;
3500 initState(*slot.scope, slot);
3501 Type const& type = slot.decl->type;
3502 if (rest.empty() && !type.isAny() && !type.admits(value)) {
3503 report(command.path, "`set` writes a value that is not a " + type.name());
3504 finish(false);
3505 return;
3506 }
3507 Value next = withPath(slot.value->peek(), rest, std::move(value));
3508 session.noteWrite();
3509 slot.value->set(std::move(next));
3510 finish(true);
3511 return;
3512 }
3513 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Element) {
3514 ElementState& element = *found->element;
3515 session.noteWrite();
3516 element.draft.set(value);
3517 if (element.bound == nullptr) {
3518 element.committed.set(std::move(value));
3519 }
3520 finish(true);
3521 return;
3522 }
3523 report(command.path, "`set` names nothing writable here");
3524 finish(false);
3525}
3526
3527inline void ScreenCore::runReset(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done) {
3528 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
3529 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(command.target);
3530 auto resetStates = [this](RtScope const& owner) {
3531 for (auto const& slot : owner.states) {
3532 if (slot->value) {
3533 Value init = runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(owner, nullptr, slot->decl->init); });
3534 slot->value->set(std::move(init));
3535 }
3536 }
3537 for (auto const& element : owner.elements) {
3538 element->draft.set(element->bound != nullptr ? runtime().untracked([&] { return element->bound->get(); })
3539 : Value{});
3540 element->committed.set(Value{});
3541 element->edited.set(false);
3542 element->touched.set(false);
3543 }
3544 };
3545 bool known = true;
3546 session.noteWrite();
3547 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::State) {
3548 StateSlot& slot = *found->state;
3549 initState(*slot.scope, slot);
3550 slot.value->set(runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*slot.scope, nullptr, slot.decl->init); }));
3551 } else if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Element) {
3552 ElementState& element = *found->element;
3553 element.submitted.set(false);
3554 if (RtScope const* const inner = element.inner.peek()) {
3555 resetStates(*inner);
3556 }
3557 } else {
3558 report(command.path, "`reset` names no state or dialog here");
3559 known = false;
3560 }
3561 done(known);
3562}
3563
3564inline void ScreenCore::runHostCommand(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done const& done) {
3565 Value const args = evalIn(*ctx.scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.value);
3566 bool const known = host != nullptr && host->hostCommand(command.target, args);
3567 if (!known) {
3568 report(command.path, "host command `" + command.target + "` is missing");
3569 }
3570 done(known);
3571}
3572
3573// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a download and an upload, each settled.
3574inline void ScreenCore::runTransfer(Command const& command, CommandCtx const& ctx, Done done) {
3575 RtScope const& scope = *ctx.scope;
3576 Value const file = evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.value);
3577 std::weak_ptr<RtScope> const weak = ctx.scope;
3578 if (command.kind == CommandKind::Download) {
3579 Value const name = evalIn(scope, ctx.bindings.get(), command.extra);
3580 auto settled = [this, weak, target = command.target, preview = command.option == "preview",
3581 done](std::expected<Value, std::string> const& reply) {
3582 auto const held = weak.lock();
3583 if (!held) {
3584 return;
3585 }
3586 runtime().batch([&] {
3587 bool const succeeded = reply.has_value();
3588 if (succeeded && preview) {
3589 NameRef const* const found = held->find(target);
3590 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::State) {
3591 initState(*found->state->scope, *found->state);
3592 session.noteWrite();
3593 found->state->value->set(*reply);
3594 }
3595 }
3596 done(succeeded);
3597 });
3598 };
3599 if (host == nullptr || !host->download(file, command.option, name, settled)) {
3600 unsupported(command, "`download`");
3601 done(false);
3602 }
3603 return;
3604 }
3605 NameRef const* const transferName = command.transfer.empty() ? nullptr : scope.find(command.transfer);
3606 TransferState* const transfer =
3607 transferName != nullptr && transferName->category == NameCategory::Transfer ? transferName->transfer : nullptr;
3608 auto progress = [weak, transfer](Value fraction) {
3609 if (weak.lock() && transfer != nullptr) {
3610 transfer->progress.set(std::move(fraction));
3611 }
3612 };
3613 auto settled = [this, weak, kept = detached(ctx), transfer, command = &command,
3614 done](std::expected<Value, std::string> reply) {
3615 auto const held = weak.lock();
3616 if (!held) {
3617 return;
3618 }
3619 runtime().batch([&] {
3620 if (transfer != nullptr) {
3621 transfer->pending.set(false);
3622 transfer->error.set(reply ? Value{} : Value{reply.error()});
3623 }
3624 if (!reply) {
3625 done(false);
3626 return;
3627 }
3628 NameRef const* const found = held->find(command->target);
3629 // The mutation's body cannot name the reference (a body is checked where the mutation is declared),
3630 // so the reference is added to it under `as`, `file` by default.
3631 MutationRuntime& mutation = *found->mutation;
3632 Value const base = evalIn(*held, kept.bindings.get(), mutation.decl().body);
3633 ValueRecord fields = base.asRecord() == nullptr ? ValueRecord{} : *base.asRecord();
3634 fields.insert_or_assign(command->binding.empty() ? std::string{"file"} : command->binding, *reply);
3635 mutation.run(Value{std::move(fields)}, std::make_shared<Bindings const>(*kept.bindings),
3636 [done](bool succeeded, Value const&) { done(succeeded); });
3637 });
3638 };
3639 if (host == nullptr) {
3640 unsupported(command, "`upload`");
3641 done(false);
3642 return;
3643 }
3644 if (transfer != nullptr) {
3645 transfer->pending.set(true);
3646 transfer->progress.set(Value{std::int64_t{0}});
3647 transfer->error.set(Value{});
3648 }
3649 NameRef const* const target = scope.find(command.target);
3650 UploadRequest request{.file = file, .modelType = {}, .action = {}};
3651 if (target != nullptr && target->category == NameCategory::Mutation && target->mutation != nullptr) {
3652 request.modelType = target->mutation->typeId();
3653 request.action = target->mutation->decl().action;
3654 }
3655 if (!host->uploadFor(request, progress, settled)) {
3656 if (transfer != nullptr) {
3657 transfer->pending.set(false);
3658 transfer->progress.set(Value{});
3659 }
3660 unsupported(command, "`upload`");
3661 done(false);
3662 }
3663}
