3669// --- Lowering --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3670
3671/// @brief A value as a `bool` property: `true` only for `true`.
3672/// @param value The value.
3673/// @param format Unused.
3674/// @return It.
3675[[nodiscard]] inline bool boolOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
3676 static_cast<void>(format);
3677 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
3678 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
3679}
3680
3681/// @brief A value as a text property.
3682/// @param value The value.
3683/// @param format The formatting facts.
3684/// @return Its text.
3685[[nodiscard]] inline std::string stringOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
3686 return textOf(value, format);
3687}
3688
3689/// @brief A value as an integer: an `int`, or a decimal truncated toward zero.
3690/// @param value The value.
3691/// @param fallback What anything else gives.
3692/// @return It.
3693[[nodiscard]] inline std::int64_t intOf(Value const& value, std::int64_t fallback) {
3694 if (std::int64_t const* const number = value.asInt()) {
3695 return *number;
3696 }
3697 if (Decimal const* const number = value.asDecimal()) {
3698 return static_cast<std::int64_t>(number->value.toDouble());
3699 }
3700 return fallback;
3701}
3702
3703/// @brief A text role by name.
3704/// @param value `normal`, `muted`, `heading` (or `title`), `error`, `success`.
3705/// @param format Unused.
3706/// @return The role; `Normal` for anything else.
3707[[nodiscard]] inline TextRole roleOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
3708 std::string const text = textOf(value, format);
3709 if (text == "muted") {
3710 return TextRole::Muted;
3711 }
3712 if (text == "heading" || text == "title") {
3713 return TextRole::Heading;
3714 }
3715 if (text == "error") {
3716 return TextRole::Error;
3717 }
3718 if (text == "success") {
3719 return TextRole::Success;
3720 }
3721 return TextRole::Normal;
3722}
3723
3724/// @brief A tone by name.
3725/// @param value `neutral`, `info`, `ok` (or `success`), `warn` (or `warning`), `err` (or `error`).
3726/// @param format Unused.
3727/// @return The tone; `Neutral` for anything else.
3728[[nodiscard]] inline Tone toneOf(Value const& value, FormatContext const& format) {
3729 std::string const text = textOf(value, format);
3730 if (text == "info") {
3731 return Tone::Info;
3732 }
3733 if (text == "ok" || text == "success") {
3734 return Tone::Ok;
3735 }
3736 if (text == "warn" || text == "warning") {
3737 return Tone::Warn;
3738 }
3739 if (text == "err" || text == "error") {
3740 return Tone::Err;
3741 }
3742 return Tone::Neutral;
3743}
3744
3745/// @brief A sizing by its document form: `"content"`, `{"fixed": n}` or `{"stretch": w}`.
3746/// @param value The value.
3747/// @return The sizing.
3748[[nodiscard]] inline Sizing sizingOf(Value const& value) {
3749 if (Value const* const fixed = value.field("fixed")) {
3750 return Sizing::fixed(static_cast<int>(intOf(*fixed, 0)));
3751 }
3752 if (Value const* const stretch = value.field("stretch")) {
3753 return Sizing::stretch(static_cast<int>(intOf(*stretch, 1)));
3754 }
3755 return Sizing::content();
3756}
3757
3758/// @brief An axis by name: `horizontal`, or vertical for anything else.
3759/// @param value The value.
3760/// @return The axis.
3761[[nodiscard]] inline Axis axisOf(Value const& value) {
3762 std::string const* const text = value.asString();
3763 return text != nullptr && *text == "horizontal" ? Axis::Horizontal : Axis::Vertical;
3764}
3765
3766/// @brief A step's state by name: `active`, `done`, `failed`, or pending for anything else.
3767/// @param name The name.
3768/// @return The state.
3769[[nodiscard]] inline StepState stepStateOf(std::string_view name) {
3770 if (name == "active") {
3771 return StepState::Active;
3772 }
3773 if (name == "done") {
3774 return StepState::Done;
3775 }
3776 return name == "failed" ? StepState::Failed : StepState::Pending;
3777}
3778
3779/// @brief The options of a select, from a list of scalars or of records with a key and a `label`.
3780/// @param options The list.
3781/// @param format The formatting facts.
3782/// @return The options.
3783[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<SelectOption> selectOptions(Value const& options, FormatContext const& format) {
3784 std::vector<SelectOption> out;
3785 if (ValueList const* const items = options.asList()) {
3786 for (Value const& option : *items) {
3787 Value const key = optionKey(option);
3788 Value const* const label = option.field("label");
3789 out.push_back(SelectOption{.key = keyOf(key), .label = textOf(label != nullptr ? *label : key, format)});
3790 }
3791 }
3792 return out;
3793}
3794
3795/// @brief Content whose scope is made when it mounts and released when it unmounts: a one-row `forEach` whose
3796/// row view builds it.
3797/// @param build Builds the content, its scope included.
3798/// @return The node.
3799[[nodiscard]] inline Node lazy(std::function<Node()> build) {
3800 return ui::forEach<int>([] { return std::vector<int>{0}; }, [](int const&) { return Key{std::int64_t{0}}; },
3801 [build = std::move(build)](reactive::Signal<int> const&) { return build(); });
3802}
3803
3804/// @brief A column of content that holds its scope for as long as it is mounted: its `visible` is a binding
3805/// that keeps the scope alive and reads nothing.
3806/// @param children The content.
3807/// @param scope The scope.
3808/// @param keys The chords of the content.
3809/// @return The node.
3810[[nodiscard]] inline Node holding(std::vector<Node> children, std::shared_ptr<RtScope> scope,
3811 std::vector<KeyBinding> keys = {}) {
3812 Column column{.children = std::move(children)};
3813 column.common.visible = Prop<bool>{[held = std::move(scope)] { return held != nullptr; }};
3814 column.common.keys = std::move(keys);
3815 return ui::column(std::move(column));
3816}
3817
3818// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): a menu nests, and lowering descends the document.
3819inline Node ScreenCore::lower(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
3820 return lowerKind(node, ctx, elementFor(*ctx.scope, node));
3821}
3822
3823inline void ScreenCore::commonOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element, Common& common) {
3824 static_cast<void>(element);
3825 common.visible = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("visible"), true, boolOf);
3826 common.enabled = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("enabled"), true, boolOf);
3827 common.tooltip = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("tooltip"), std::string{}, stringOf);
3828 if (ExprPtr const sizing = node.prop("sizing")) {
3829 common.layout.width = sizingOf(once(ctx, sizing));
3830 }
3831 common.testId = std::string{node.name("testId")};
3832 common.surface = std::string{node.name("surface")};
3833 if (ExprPtr const autofocus = node.prop("autofocus")) {
3834 common.autofocus = boolOf(once(ctx, autofocus), session.formatting());
3835 }
3836 for (DocNodePtr const& a11y : node.partList("a11y")) {
3837 common.a11y.name = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, a11y->prop("name"), std::string{}, stringOf);
3838 common.a11y.role = std::string{a11y->name("role")};
3839 }
3840 for (DocNodePtr const& drag : node.partList("drag")) {
3841 ExprPtr const payload = drag->prop("payload");
3842 common.dragKey = slotProp<std::optional<Key>>(
3843 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, payload]() -> std::optional<Key> {
3844 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), payload);
3845 return value.isNull() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Key>{keyOf(value)};
3846 });
3847 }
3848 for (DocNodePtr const& drop : node.partList("drop")) {
3849 ExprPtr const accepts = drop->prop("accepts");
3850 common.accepts = [this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, accepts](Key const& key) {
3851 if (!accepts) {
3852 return true;
3853 }
3854 Value const accepted = runtime().untracked([&] { return evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), accepts); });
3855 if (ValueList const* const items = accepted.asList()) {
3856 return std::ranges::any_of(*items, [&](Value const& item) { return keyOf(item) == key; });
3857 }
3858 return accepted.isNull() || keyOf(accepted) == key;
3859 };
3860 common.onDrop = [this, ctx, commands = drop->event("onDrop")](Key const& key) {
3861 runEvent(commands, ctx, valueOfKey(key));
3862 };
3863 }
3864 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : node.keys) {
3865 common.keys.push_back(
3866 KeyBinding{.chord = chord, .onPress = [this, ctx, list = &commands] { runEvent(list, ctx, Value{}); }});
3867 }
3868}
3869
3870inline void ScreenCore::fieldOf(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element, FieldState& field) {
3871 field.readonly = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("readonly"), false, boolOf);
3872 field.required = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("required"), false, boolOf);
3873 field.stale = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("stale"), false, boolOf);
3874 if (element != nullptr) {
3875 field.errors = slotProp<std::vector<std::string>>(
3876 [this, scope = ctx.scope, element] { return stringsOf(elementValue(*element, "shownErrors")); });
3877 } else if (ExprPtr const errors = node.prop("errors")) {
3878 field.errors = slotProp<std::vector<std::string>>([scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, errors] {
3879 return stringsOf(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), errors));
3880 });
3881 }
3882}
3883
3884inline std::vector<MenuItem> ScreenCore::menuItems(std::span<DocNodePtr const> parts, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
3885 std::vector<MenuItem> items;
3886 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
3887 MenuItem item;
3888 item.label = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf);
3889 if (Commands const* const commands = part->event("onClick")) {
3890 item.onSelect = [this, ctx, commands] { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
3891 }
3892 if (ExprPtr const icon = part->prop("icon")) {
3893 item.icon = textOf(once(ctx, icon), session.formatting());
3894 }
3895 item.keys = std::string{part->name("keys")};
3896 if (ExprPtr const checked = part->prop("checked")) {
3897 item.checked = slotProp<std::optional<bool>>(
3898 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, checked]() -> std::optional<bool> {
3899 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), checked);
3900 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
3901 return flag == nullptr ? std::nullopt : std::optional<bool>{*flag};
3902 });
3903 }
3904 item.enabled = bindProp<bool>(ctx, part->prop("enabled"), true, boolOf);
3905 item.items = menuItems(part->partList("items"), ctx);
3906 items.push_back(std::move(item));
3907 }
3908 return items;
3909}
3910
3911// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): one case per kind of ui/1.
3912inline Node ScreenCore::lowerKind(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
3913 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
3914 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
3915 auto children = [&](std::string_view key) {
3916 std::vector<Node> out;
3917 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes(key)) {
3918 out.push_back(lower(*child, ctx));
3919 }
3920 return out;
3921 };
3922 auto child = [&](std::string_view key) -> Node {
3923 auto const nodes = node.nodes(key);
3924 return nodes.empty() ? Node{} : lowerAll(nodes, ctx);
3925 };
3926 auto onceInt = [&](std::string_view key, std::int64_t fallback) {
3927 ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key);
3928 return expr ? intOf(once(ctx, expr), fallback) : fallback;
3929 };
3930 auto onceBool = [&](std::string_view key, bool fallback) {
3931 ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key);
3932 return expr ? boolOf(once(ctx, expr), format) : fallback;
3933 };
3934 auto onceText = [&](std::string_view key) {
3935 ExprPtr const expr = node.prop(key);
3936 return expr ? textOf(once(ctx, expr), format) : std::string{};
3937 };
3938 auto textProp = [&](std::string_view key) {
3939 return bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop(key), std::string{}, stringOf);
3940 };
3941 auto action = [&](std::string_view key) -> Action {
3942 Commands const* const commands = node.event(key);
3943 if (commands == nullptr) {
3944 return {};
3945 }
3946 return [this, ctx, commands] { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
3947 };
3948 auto actionPart = [&]() {
3949 ActionButton button;
3950 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("action")) {
3951 button.label = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, part->prop("label"), std::string{}, stringOf);
3952 if (Commands const* const commands = part->event("onClick")) {
3953 button.onClick = [this, ctx, commands] { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{}); };
3954 }
3955 }
3956 return button;
3957 };
3958 auto read = [element, this](std::string_view name) {
3959 return [element, this, name = std::string{name}] { return elementValue(*element, name); };
3960 };
3961
3962 if (kind == "text") {
3963 Text spec{.text = textProp("text"),
3964 .role = bindProp<TextRole>(ctx, node.prop("role"), TextRole::Normal, roleOf)};
3965 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
3966 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
3967 return ui::text(std::move(spec));
3968 }
3969 if (kind == "button") {
3970 Button spec{.label = textProp("label")};
3971 Commands const* const onClick = node.event("onClick");
3972 Commands const* const onActivate = node.event("onActivate");
3973 if (onClick != nullptr || onActivate != nullptr) {
3974 spec.onClick = [this, ctx, onClick, onActivate] {
3975 runEvent(onClick, ctx, Value{});
3976 runEvent(onActivate, ctx, Value{});
3977 };
3978 }
3979 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
3980 return ui::button(std::move(spec));
3981 }
3982 if (kind == "textInput") {
3983 std::string const commitOn = node.name("commitOn").empty() ? "change" : std::string{node.name("commitOn")};
3984 auto commit = [this, ctx, element, commitOn, onChange = node.event("onChange")](std::string const& when,
3985 std::string const& text) {
3986 if (commitOn != when) {
3987 return;
3988 }
3989 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
3990 session.noteWrite();
3991 element->committed.set(Value{text});
3992 }
3993 runEvent(onChange, ctx, Value{text});
3994 };
3995 TextInput spec;
3996 spec.value =
3997 slotProp<std::string>([this, element] { return textOf(element->draft.get(), session.formatting()); });
3998 spec.onChange = [this, element, commit](std::string text) {
3999 session.asUser([&] {
4000 session.noteWrite();
4001 element->draft.set(Value{text});
4002 element->edited.set(true);
4003 });
4004 commit("change", text);
4005 };
4006 spec.onCommit = [this, ctx, element, commit, onCommit = node.event("onCommit")](std::string const& text) {
4007 element->touched.set(true);
4008 commit("blur", text);
4009 runEvent(onCommit, ctx, Value{text});
4010 };
4011 spec.onSubmit = [this, ctx, commit, onSubmit = node.event("onSubmit")](std::string const& text) {
4012 commit("enter", text);
4013 runEvent(onSubmit, ctx, Value{text});
4014 };
4015 spec.placeholder = textProp("placeholder");
4016 std::string const mode = onceText("mode");
4017 spec.mode = TextInputMode::SingleLine;
4018 if (mode == "multiline") {
4019 spec.mode = TextInputMode::Multiline;
4020 } else if (mode == "password") {
4021 spec.mode = TextInputMode::Password;
4022 }
4023 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
4024 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4025 return ui::textInput(std::move(spec));
4026 }
4027 if (kind == "checkbox") {
4028 Checkbox spec{.label = textProp("label"), .checked = slotProp<bool>([read = read("checked")] {
4029 Value const value = read();
4030 bool const* const flag = value.asBool();
4031 return flag != nullptr && *flag;
4032 })};
4033 spec.onToggle = [this, ctx, element, onToggle = node.event("onToggle"),
4034 onChange = node.event("onChange")](bool checked) {
4035 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
4036 session.asUser([&] {
4037 session.noteWrite();
4038 element->draft.set(checked);
4039 });
4040 }
4041 runEvent(onToggle, ctx, Value{checked});
4042 runEvent(onChange, ctx, Value{checked});
4043 };
4044 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
4045 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4046 return ui::checkbox(std::move(spec));
4047 }
4048 if (kind == "select") {
4049 Select spec;
4050 spec.options = slotProp<std::vector<SelectOption>>(
4051 [this, element] { return selectOptions(element->rows->get(), session.formatting()); });
4052 spec.selected = slotProp<std::optional<Key>>([read = read("selected")]() -> std::optional<Key> {
4053 Value const selected = read();
4054 return selected.isNull() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Key>{keyOf(selected)};
4055 });
4056 spec.onSelect = [this, ctx, element, onChoose = node.event("onChoose"),
4057 onChange = node.event("onChange")](Key const& key) {
4058 Value const chosen = valueOfKey(key);
4059 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
4060 session.asUser([&] {
4061 session.noteWrite();
4062 element->draft.set(chosen);
4063 });
4064 }
4065 runEvent(onChoose, ctx, chosen);
4066 runEvent(onChange, ctx, chosen);
4067 };
4068 spec.style = onceText("style") == "radio" ? SelectStyle::Radio : SelectStyle::Dropdown;
4069 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
4070 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4071 return ui::select(std::move(spec));
4072 }
4073 if (kind == "slider") {
4074 Slider spec;
4075 spec.value = slotProp<std::int64_t>([read = read("value"), element] {
4076 return intOf(element->bound != nullptr ? read() : element->draft.get(), 0);
4077 });
4078 spec.minimum = onceInt("min", 0);
4079 spec.maximum = onceInt("max", 100);
4080 spec.step = onceInt("step", 1);
4081 spec.onChange = [this, ctx, element, onChange = node.event("onChange")](std::int64_t value) {
4082 session.asUser([&] {
4083 session.noteWrite();
4084 element->draft.set(value);
4085 element->edited.set(true);
4086 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
4087 element->committed.set(value);
4088 }
4089 });
4090 runEvent(onChange, ctx, Value{value});
4091 };
4092 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
4093 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4094 return ui::slider(std::move(spec));
4095 }
4096 if (kind == "dateTimeInput") {
4097 DateTimeInput spec;
4098 spec.value = slotProp<std::optional<time::Timestamp>>([element]() -> std::optional<time::Timestamp> {
4099 time::DateTime const* const instant = element->draft.get().asTimestamp();
4100 return instant == nullptr ? std::nullopt : std::optional<time::Timestamp>{time::Timestamp{*instant}};
4101 });
4102 spec.onChange = [this, ctx, element, onChange = node.event("onChange")](std::optional<time::Timestamp> value) {
4103 Value const entered = value && value->hasValue() ? Value{*value->value} : Value{};
4104 session.asUser([&] {
4105 session.noteWrite();
4106 element->draft.set(entered);
4107 element->edited.set(true);
4108 if (element->bound == nullptr) {
4109 element->committed.set(entered);
4110 }
4111 });
4112 runEvent(onChange, ctx, entered);
4113 };
4114 spec.mode = onceText("mode") == "date" ? DateMode::Date : DateMode::DateTime;
4115 spec.offsetMinutes = format.utcOffsetMinutes;
4116 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
4117 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4118 return ui::dateTimeInput(std::move(spec));
4119 }
4120 if (kind == "filePicker") {
4121 FilePicker spec;
4122 spec.path =
4123 slotProp<std::string>([this, element] { return textOf(element->draft.get(), session.formatting()); });
4124 spec.onPicked = [this, ctx, element, onPick = node.event("onPick")](std::string path) {
4125 session.asUser([&] {
4126 session.noteWrite();
4127 element->draft.set(Value{path});
4128 element->committed.set(Value{path});
4129 });
4130 runEvent(onPick, ctx, Value{path});
4131 };
4132 spec.mode = onceText("mode") == "save" ? FilePickerMode::Save : FilePickerMode::Open;
4133 fieldOf(node, ctx, element, spec.field);
4134 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4135 return ui::filePicker(std::move(spec));
4136 }
4137 if (kind == "menu") {
4138 Menu spec{.items = menuItems(node.partList("items"), ctx)};
4139 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4140 return ui::menu(std::move(spec));
4141 }
4142 if (kind == "column" || kind == "row") {
4143 int const gap = static_cast<int>(onceInt("gap", 0));
4144 if (kind == "column") {
4145 Column spec{.children = children("children"), .gap = gap};
4146 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4147 return ui::column(std::move(spec));
4148 }
4149 Row spec{.children = children("children"), .gap = gap};
4150 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4151 return ui::row(std::move(spec));
4152 }
4153 if (kind == "grid") {
4154 Grid spec{.columns = static_cast<int>(onceInt("columns", 1)), .gap = static_cast<int>(onceInt("gap", 0))};
4155 for (DocNodePtr const& cell : node.nodes("children")) {
4156 ExprPtr const span = cell->prop("span");
4157 spec.cells.push_back(
4158 GridCell{.node = lower(*cell, ctx), .span = static_cast<int>(span ? intOf(once(ctx, span), 1) : 1)});
4159 }
4160 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4161 return ui::grid(std::move(spec));
4162 }
4163 if (kind == "spacer") {
4164 Spacer spec;
4165 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4166 return ui::spacer(std::move(spec));
4167 }
4168 if (kind == "panel") {
4169 Panel spec{.title = textProp("title"), .padding = static_cast<int>(onceInt("padding", 0))};
4170 spec.child = child("children");
4171 spec.collapsible = onceBool("collapsible", false);
4172 spec.collapsed = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("collapsed"), false, boolOf);
4173 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4174 return ui::panel(std::move(spec));
4175 }
4176 if (kind == "scroll") {
4177 ExprPtr const axis = node.prop("axis");
4178 Scroll spec{.child = child("children"), .axis = axis ? axisOf(once(ctx, axis)) : Axis::Vertical};
4179 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4180 return ui::scroll(std::move(spec));
4181 }
4182 if (kind == "switch") {
4183 return lowerSwitch(node, ctx);
4184 }
4185 if (kind == "tabs") {
4186 Tabs spec;
4187 for (DocNodePtr const& tab : node.partList("tabs")) {
4188 ExprPtr const label = tab->prop("label");
4189 auto const nodes = tab->nodes("children");
4190 spec.tabs.push_back(Tab{.label = label ? textOf(once(ctx, label), format) : std::string{},
4191 .node = nodes.empty() ? Node{} : lowerAll(nodes, ctx)});
4192 }
4193 spec.selected = std::size_t{0};
4194 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4195 return ui::tabs(std::move(spec));
4196 }
4197 if (kind == "dialog" || kind == "drawer") {
4198 return lowerDialog(node, ctx, element);
4199 }
4200 if (kind == "busy") {
4201 Busy spec{.active = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("active"), false, boolOf), .label = textProp("label")};
4202 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4203 return ui::busy(std::move(spec));
4204 }
4205 if (kind == "forEach" || kind == "table") {
4206 return lowerRows(node, ctx, element);
4207 }
4208 if (kind == "banner") {
4209 Banner spec{.tone = bindProp<Tone>(ctx, node.prop("tone"), Tone::Info, toneOf), .text = textProp("text")};
4210 spec.action = actionPart();
4211 spec.dismissible = onceBool("dismissible", false);
4212 spec.onDismiss = action("onDismiss");
4213 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4214 return ui::banner(std::move(spec));
4215 }
4216 if (kind == "badge") {
4217 Badge spec{.tone = bindProp<Tone>(ctx, node.prop("tone"), Tone::Neutral, toneOf), .text = textProp("text")};
4218 spec.icon = onceText("icon");
4219 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4220 return ui::badge(std::move(spec));
4221 }
4222 if (kind == "progress") {
4223 Progress spec;
4224 spec.value = slotProp<std::optional<double>>(
4225 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr = node.prop("value")]() -> std::optional<double> {
4226 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr);
4227 if (std::int64_t const* const number = value.asInt()) {
4228 return static_cast<double>(*number);
4229 }
4230 if (Decimal const* const number = value.asDecimal()) {
4231 return number->value.toDouble();
4232 }
4233 return std::nullopt;
4234 });
4235 spec.label = textProp("label");
4236 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4237 return ui::progress(std::move(spec));
4238 }
4239 if (kind == "steps") {
4240 Steps spec;
4241 spec.items =
4242 slotProp<std::vector<Step>>([this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr = node.prop("items")] {
4243 std::vector<Step> steps;
4244 Value const items = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr);
4245 if (ValueList const* const list = items.asList()) {
4246 for (Value const& item : *list) {
4247 Value const* const label = item.field("label");
4248 Value const* const state = item.field("state");
4249 std::string const name = state == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*state, {});
4250 steps.push_back(
4251 Step{.label = label == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*label, session.formatting()),
4252 .state = stepStateOf(name)});
4253 }
4254 }
4255 return steps;
4256 });
4257 spec.current = slotProp<std::optional<std::size_t>>(
4258 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr = node.prop("current")]() -> std::optional<std::size_t> {
4259 std::int64_t const index = intOf(evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr), -1);
4260 return index < 0 ? std::nullopt : std::optional<std::size_t>{static_cast<std::size_t>(index)};
4261 });
4262 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4263 return ui::steps(std::move(spec));
4264 }
4265 if (kind == "keyValue") {
4266 KeyValue spec;
4267 spec.items = slotProp<std::vector<KeyValueItem>>(
4268 [this, scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, expr = node.prop("items")] {
4269 std::vector<KeyValueItem> out;
4270 Value const items = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), expr);
4271 if (ValueList const* const list = items.asList()) {
4272 for (Value const& item : *list) {
4273 Value const* const label = item.field("label");
4274 Value const* const value = item.field("value");
4275 out.push_back(KeyValueItem{
4276 .label = label == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*label, session.formatting()),
4277 .value = value == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*value, session.formatting())});
4278 }
4279 }
4280 return out;
4281 });
4282 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4283 return ui::keyValue(std::move(spec));
4284 }
4285 if (kind == "emptyState") {
4286 EmptyState spec{.title = textProp("title"), .text = textProp("text")};
4287 spec.icon = onceText("icon");
4288 spec.action = actionPart();
4289 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4290 return ui::emptyState(std::move(spec));
4291 }
4292 if (kind == "splitter") {
4293 ExprPtr const orientation = node.prop("orientation");
4294 Splitter spec{.children = children("children"),
4295 .orientation = orientation && axisOf(once(ctx, orientation)) == Axis::Vertical
4296 ? Axis::Vertical
4297 : Axis::Horizontal};
4298 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4299 return ui::splitter(std::move(spec));
4300 }
4301 if (kind == "collapsible") {
4302 Collapsible spec{.title = textProp("title"), .open = bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("open"), true, boolOf)};
4303 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event("onToggle")) {
4304 spec.onToggle = [this, ctx, commands](bool open) { runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{open}); };
4305 }
4306 spec.header = child("header");
4307 spec.child = child("children");
4308 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4309 return ui::collapsible(std::move(spec));
4310 }
4311 if (kind == "dropZone") {
4312 DropZone spec;
4313 spec.accept = stringsOf(node.prop("accept") ? once(ctx, node.prop("accept")) : Value{});
4314 spec.multiple = onceBool("multiple", false);
4315 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event("onDrop")) {
4316 spec.onDrop = [this, ctx, commands](std::vector<std::string> const& paths) {
4317 runEvent(commands, ctx, listOfStrings(paths));
4318 };
4319 }
4320 spec.child = child("children");
4321 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4322 return ui::dropZone(std::move(spec));
4323 }
4324 if (kind == "boundary") {
4325 return lowerBoundary(node, ctx);
4326 }
4327 if (kind == "custom") {
4328 return lowerCustom(node, ctx);
4329 }
4330 if (kind == "customize") {
4331 return lowerCustomize(node, ctx);
4332 }
4333 report(node.path, "`" + node.kind + "` needs the forms engine, which this interpreter does not lower yet");
4334 return ui::text(Text{.text = std::string{node.kind}, .role = TextRole::Muted});
4335}

4337inline Node ScreenCore::lowerDialog(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
4338 Prop<bool> open = node.prop("open") ? bindProp<bool>(ctx, node.prop("open"), false, boolOf)
4339 : slotProp<bool>([element] { return element->open.get(); });
4340 Node body = lazy([this, ctx, &node, element]() -> Node {
4341 auto inner = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, ctx.scope, nullptr, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 2);
4342 inner->owner = element;
4343 inner->submitted = &element->submitted;
4344 inner->showErrors = std::string{node.name("showErrors")};
4345 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
4346 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
4347 content.push_back(child.get());
4348 }
4349 std::vector<Commands const*> lists;
4350 for (std::string_view const key : {"default", "cancel"}) {
4351 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event(key)) {
4352 lists.push_back(commands);
4353 }
4354 }
4355 declare(*inner, node.scope ? &*node.scope : nullptr, content, lists);
4356 element->inner.set(inner.get());
4357 LowerCtx const innerCtx{.scope = inner, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
4358 std::vector<Node> children;
4359 children.reserve(content.size());
4360 for (DocNode const* const child : content) {
4361 children.push_back(lower(*child, innerCtx));
4362 }
4363 std::vector<KeyBinding> keys;
4364 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event("default")) {
4365 keys.push_back(KeyBinding{
4366 .chord = "Enter", .onPress = [this, innerCtx, commands] { runEvent(commands, innerCtx, Value{}); }});
4367 }
4368 if (Commands const* const commands = node.event("cancel")) {
4369 keys.push_back(KeyBinding{
4370 .chord = "Esc", .onPress = [this, innerCtx, commands] { runEvent(commands, innerCtx, Value{}); }});
4371 }
4372 return holding(std::move(children), inner, std::move(keys));
4373 });
4374 Action onDismiss = [this, ctx, element, commands = node.event("onDismiss")] {
4375 session.asUser([&] {
4376 session.noteWrite();
4377 element->open.set(false);
4378 });
4379 runEvent(commands, ctx, Value{});
4380 };
4381 if (node.kind == "drawer") {
4382 ExprPtr const side = node.prop("side");
4383 Drawer spec{
4384 .open = std::move(open),
4385 .title = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("title"), std::string{}, stringOf),
4386 .child = std::move(body),
4387 .onDismiss = std::move(onDismiss),
4388 .side = side && textOf(once(ctx, side), session.formatting()) == "start" ? Side::Start : Side::End};
4389 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4390 return ui::drawer(std::move(spec));
4391 }
4392 Dialog spec{.open = std::move(open),
4393 .title = bindProp<std::string>(ctx, node.prop("title"), std::string{}, stringOf),
4394 .child = std::move(body),
4395 .onDismiss = std::move(onDismiss)};
4396 commonOf(node, ctx, element, spec.common);
4397 return ui::dialog(std::move(spec));
4398}
4399
4400inline Node ScreenCore::lowerSwitch(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
4401 std::vector<ExprPtr> whens;
4402 Switch spec;
4403 std::int64_t index = 0;
4404 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("cases")) {
4405 whens.push_back(part->prop("when"));
4406 DocNode const* const casePart = part.get();
4407 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{
4408 .key = Key{index++},
4409 .node = lazy([this, ctx, casePart]() -> Node {
4410 auto inner = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, ctx.scope, nullptr, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 2);
4411 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
4412 for (DocNodePtr const& child : casePart->nodes("children")) {
4413 content.push_back(child.get());
4414 }
4415 declare(*inner, casePart->scope ? &*casePart->scope : nullptr, content, {});
4416 LowerCtx const innerCtx{.scope = inner, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
4417 std::vector<Node> children;
4418 children.reserve(content.size());
4419 for (DocNode const* const child : content) {
4420 children.push_back(lower(*child, innerCtx));
4421 }
4422 return holding(std::move(children), inner);
4423 })});
4424 }
4425 spec.selector = slotProp<Key>(
4426 [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, selected = node.prop("on"), whens = std::move(whens)] {
4427 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), selected);
4428 for (std::size_t at = 0; at < whens.size(); ++at) {
4429 if (evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), whens.at(at)) == value) {
4430 return Key{static_cast<std::int64_t>(at)};
4431 }
4432 }
4433 return Key{std::int64_t{-1}};
4434 });
4435 auto const fallback = node.nodes("default");
4436 spec.fallback = fallback.empty() ? Node{} : lowerAll(fallback, ctx);
4437 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, spec.common);
4438 return ui::switchOf(std::move(spec));
4439}
4440
4441inline std::shared_ptr<RtScope> ScreenCore::rowScope(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx,
4442 reactive::Signal<Value> const& row,
4443 std::vector<DocNode const*> const& content) {
4444 auto scope = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, ctx.scope, &row, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 2);
4445 declare(*scope, node.scope ? &*node.scope : nullptr, content, {});
4446 return scope;
4447}
4448
4449// NOLINTNEXTLINE(readability-function-cognitive-complexity): a list of rows and a table.
4450inline Node ScreenCore::lowerRows(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx, ElementState* element) {
4451 ExprPtr const rowsExpr = node.prop("rows");
4452 if (!rowsExpr) {
4453 report(node.path, "a model-backed `table` needs the table engine, which this interpreter does not lower yet");
4454 return ui::text(Text{.text = std::string{"table"}, .role = TextRole::Muted});
4455 }
4456 auto rows = [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, rowsExpr] {
4457 Value const value = evalIn(*scope, bindings.get(), rowsExpr);
4458 ValueList const* const items = value.asList();
4459 return items == nullptr ? std::vector<Value>{} : std::vector<Value>{items->begin(), items->end()};
4460 };
4461 auto keyFn = [scope = ctx.scope, bindings = ctx.bindings, keyExpr = node.prop("key")](Value const& row) -> Key {
4462 if (!keyExpr) {
4463 Value const rowKey = rowId(row);
4464 return keyOf(rowKey.isNull() ? row : rowKey);
4465 }
4466 ScopeEnv const env{*scope, bindings.get(), &row};
4467 return keyOf(evaluate(*keyExpr, env));
4468 };
4469 if (node.kind == "forEach") {
4470 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
4471 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
4472 content.push_back(child.get());
4473 }
4474 auto rowView = [this, ctx, &node, content](reactive::Signal<Value> const& row) -> Node {
4475 auto scope = rowScope(node, ctx, row, content);
4476 LowerCtx const rowCtx{.scope = scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
4477 std::vector<Node> children;
4478 children.reserve(content.size());
4479 for (DocNode const* const child : content) {
4480 children.push_back(lower(*child, rowCtx));
4481 }
4482 return holding(std::move(children), scope);
4483 };
4484 ExprPtr const axis = node.prop("axis");
4485 ExprPtr const gap = node.prop("gap");
4486 return ui::forEach<Value>(std::move(rows), std::move(keyFn), std::move(rowView),
4487 axis ? axisOf(once(ctx, axis)) : Axis::Vertical,
4488 gap ? static_cast<int>(intOf(once(ctx, gap), 0)) : 0);
4489 }
4490 std::vector<TableColumn> columns;
4491 std::vector<DocNode const*> cells;
4492 std::vector<std::string> fields;
4493 FormatContext const& format = session.formatting();
4494 if (ExprPtr const derived = node.prop("columns")) {
4495 Value const list = once(ctx, derived);
4496 if (ValueList const* const items = list.asList()) {
4497 for (Value const& item : *items) {
4498 Value const* const field = item.field("id");
4499 Value const* const label = item.field("label");
4500 fields.push_back(field == nullptr ? std::string{} : textOf(*field, format));
4501 columns.push_back(
4502 TableColumn{.label = textOf(label != nullptr ? *label : Value{fields.back()}, format)});
4503 cells.push_back(nullptr);
4504 }
4505 }
4506 }
4507 for (DocNodePtr const& part : node.partList("columns")) {
4508 ExprPtr const label = part->prop("label");
4509 ExprPtr const width = part->prop("width");
4510 columns.push_back(TableColumn{.label = label ? textOf(once(ctx, label), format) : std::string{},
4511 .width = width ? sizingOf(once(ctx, width)) : Sizing::content()});
4512 cells.push_back(part.get());
4513 fields.emplace_back(part->id);
4514 }
4515 auto registry = std::make_shared<std::map<std::string, std::weak_ptr<RtScope>, std::less<>>>();
4516 auto cellsOf = [this, ctx, &node, cells, fields, registry, keyFn](reactive::Signal<Value> const& row) {
4517 std::vector<DocNode const*> content;
4518 for (DocNode const* const column : cells) {
4519 if (column != nullptr) {
4520 for (DocNodePtr const& cell : column->nodes("cell")) {
4521 content.push_back(cell.get());
4522 }
4523 }
4524 }
4525 auto scope = rowScope(node, ctx, row, content);
4526 (*registry)[canonicalJson(valueOfKey(keyFn(row.peek())))] = scope;
4527 LowerCtx const rowCtx{.scope = scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
4528 std::vector<Node> out;
4529 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < cells.size(); ++index) {
4530 DocNode const* const column = cells.at(index);
4531 auto const nodes = column == nullptr ? std::span<DocNodePtr const>{} : column->nodes("cell");
4532 if (!nodes.empty()) {
4533 out.push_back(lowerAll(nodes, rowCtx));
4534 continue;
4535 }
4536 out.push_back(ui::text(Text{.text = slotProp<std::string>([this, &row, field = fields.at(index)] {
4537 Value const* const value = row.get().field(field);
4538 return value == nullptr ? std::string{}
4539 : textOf(*value, session.formatting());
4540 })}));
4541 }
4542 if (!out.empty()) {
4543 out.front() = holding({out.front()}, scope);
4544 }
4545 return out;
4546 };
4547 TableOptions options;
4548 std::string const mode =
4549 node.prop("selectionMode") ? textOf(once(ctx, node.prop("selectionMode")), format) : std::string{};
4550 options.selectionMode = SelectionMode::None;
4551 if (mode == "single") {
4552 options.selectionMode = SelectionMode::Single;
4553 } else if (mode == "multiple") {
4554 options.selectionMode = SelectionMode::Multiple;
4555 }
4556 options.selection = slotProp<std::vector<Key>>([element] {
4557 std::vector<Key> keys;
4558 if (ValueList const* const items = element->selection.get().asList()) {
4559 for (Value const& item : *items) {
4560 keys.push_back(keyOf(item));
4561 }
4562 }
4563 return keys;
4564 });
4565 options.onSelectionChange = [this, element](std::vector<Key> const& keys) {
4566 ValueList items;
4567 for (Key const& key : keys) {
4568 items.push_back(valueOfKey(key));
4569 }
4570 session.asUser([&] {
4571 session.noteWrite();
4572 element->selection.set(Value{std::move(items)});
4573 });
4574 };
4575 options.onActivate = [this, ctx, element, registry, commands = node.event("onActivate")](Key const& key) {
4576 Value const activated = valueOfKey(key);
4577 session.asUser([&] {
4578 session.noteWrite();
4579 element->activeKey.set(activated);
4580 });
4581 auto const found = registry->find(canonicalJson(activated));
4582 std::shared_ptr<RtScope> const scope = found == registry->end() ? nullptr : found->second.lock();
4583 LowerCtx const rowCtx{.scope = scope ? scope : ctx.scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = ctx.boundary};
4584 runEvent(commands, rowCtx, activated);
4585 };
4586 commonOf(node, ctx, element, options.common);
4587 return ui::table<Value>(std::move(columns), std::move(rows), std::move(keyFn), std::move(cellsOf),
4588 std::move(options));
4589}
4590
4591inline void ScreenCore::ownQueriesOf(ExprPtr const& expr, RtScope const& scope, BoundaryRuntime& boundary,
4592 std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& seen) {
4593 if (!expr) {
4594 return;
4595 }
4596 bool const control = expr->kind == ExprKind::Query || expr->kind == ExprKind::Pending ||
4597 expr->kind == ExprKind::Error || expr->kind == ExprKind::ErrorKind;
4598 if (control || expr->kind == ExprKind::Ref) {
4599 NameRef const* const found = scope.find(expr->name);
4600 if (found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Query && seen.insert(expr->name).second) {
4601 boundary.queries.push_back(found->query);
4602 }
4603 if (expr->kind == ExprKind::Ref && found != nullptr && found->category == NameCategory::Let &&
4604 seen.insert("let:" + expr->name).second) {
4605 ownQueriesOf(found->letExpr, scope, boundary, seen);
4606 }
4607 }
4608 for (ExprPtr const& arg : expr->args) {
4609 ownQueriesOf(arg, scope, boundary, seen);
4610 }
4611 for (auto const& [name, field] : expr->fields) {
4612 static_cast<void>(name);
4613 ownQueriesOf(field, scope, boundary, seen);
4614 }
4615}
4616
4617inline void ScreenCore::ownQueries(DocNode const& node, RtScope const& scope, BoundaryRuntime& boundary,
4618 std::set<std::string, std::less<>>& seen) {
4619 if (node.kind == "boundary") {
4620 return;
4621 }
4622 for (auto const& [key, expr] : node.props) {
4623 static_cast<void>(key);
4624 ownQueriesOf(expr, scope, boundary, seen);
4625 }
4626 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : node.children) {
4627 static_cast<void>(key);
4628 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
4629 ownQueries(*child, scope, boundary, seen);
4630 }
4631 }
4632 for (auto const& [key, parts] : node.parts) {
4633 static_cast<void>(key);
4634 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
4635 ownQueries(*part, scope, boundary, seen);
4636 }
4637 }
4638}
4639
4640inline Node ScreenCore::lowerBoundary(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
4641 auto boundary = std::make_shared<BoundaryRuntime>();
4642 std::set<std::string, std::less<>> seen;
4643 for (DocNodePtr const& child : node.nodes("children")) {
4644 ownQueries(*child, *ctx.scope, *boundary, seen);
4645 }
4646 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>(*ctx.bindings);
4647 bindings->push_back(Binding{.name = "boundary", .read = [boundary] {
4648 for (QueryRuntime const* const query : boundary->queries) {
4649 Value const error = query->error();
4650 if (!error.isNull() && query->value().isNull()) {
4651 return Value{ValueRecord{{"error", error}}};
4652 }
4653 }
4654 return Value{ValueRecord{{"error", Value{}}}};
4655 }});
4656 LowerCtx const errorCtx{.scope = ctx.scope, .bindings = bindings, .boundary = boundary};
4657 LowerCtx const childCtx{.scope = ctx.scope, .bindings = ctx.bindings, .boundary = boundary};
4658 auto group = [this](std::span<DocNodePtr const> nodes, LowerCtx const& where) -> Node {
4659 return nodes.empty() ? ui::spacer() : lowerAll(nodes, where);
4660 };
4661 Switch spec;
4662 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{.key = Key{std::int64_t{0}}, .node = group(node.nodes("loading"), childCtx)});
4663 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{.key = Key{std::int64_t{1}}, .node = group(node.nodes("error"), errorCtx)});
4664 spec.cases.push_back(SwitchCase{.key = Key{std::int64_t{2}}, .node = group(node.nodes("children"), childCtx)});
4665 spec.selector = slotProp<Key>([boundary] {
4666 bool loading = false;
4667 for (QueryRuntime const* const query : boundary->queries) {
4668 if (!query->settled()) {
4669 loading = true;
4670 } else if (query->value().isNull() && !query->error().isNull()) {
4671 return Key{std::int64_t{1}};
4672 }
4673 }
4674 return Key{std::int64_t{loading ? 0 : 2}};
4675 });
4676 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, spec.common);
4677 return ui::switchOf(std::move(spec));
4678}
4679
4680inline Node ScreenCore::lowerCustom(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
4681 std::string const name{node.name("name")};
4682 // A loaded document's custom node names a declared component, and every component has a fallback.
4683 Component const& component = _doc->components.at(name);
4684 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, ExprPtr>> props;
4685 for (DocNodePtr const& record : node.partList("props")) {
4686 for (auto const& [key, expr] : record->props) {
4687 props.emplace_back(key, expr);
4688 }
4689 }
4690 auto bindings = std::make_shared<Bindings>();
4691 bindings->push_back(
4692 Binding{.name = "props", .read = [scope = ctx.scope, outer = ctx.bindings, props = std::move(props)] {
4693 ValueRecord record;
4694 for (auto const& [key, expr] : props) {
4695 record.insert_or_assign(key, evalIn(*scope, outer.get(), expr));
4696 }
4697 return Value{std::move(record)};
4698 }});
4699 auto scope = std::make_shared<RtScope>(*this, nullptr, nullptr, ctx.scope->nodes.depth() + 1);
4700 DocNode const& fallback = *component.fallback;
4701 declare(*scope, nullptr, {&fallback}, {});
4702 Node lowered = lower(fallback, LowerCtx{.scope = scope, .bindings = bindings, .boundary = nullptr});
4703 return ui::custom(Custom{.name = name, .fallback = std::move(lowered)});
4704}
4705
4706inline Node ScreenCore::lowerCustomize(DocNode const& node, LowerCtx const& ctx) {
4707 std::string const point{node.name("point")};
4708 // A loaded document's customize node names a declared point, and every point has a choice in `prefs`.
4709 CustomizePoint const& spec = _doc->customize.at(point);
4710 auto choose = [this, point](Value value) {
4711 session.asUser([&] {
4712 ValueRecord next = prefs.peek();
4713 next.insert_or_assign(point, value);
4714 prefs.set(std::move(next));
4715 });
4716 if (host != nullptr) {
4717 host->preferenceChanged(_doc->id, point, value);
4718 }
4719 };
4720 if (spec.kind == "choice") {
4721 Select select;
4722 std::vector<SelectOption> options;
4723 options.reserve(spec.options.size());
4724 for (std::string const& option : spec.options) {
4725 options.push_back(SelectOption{.key = Key{option}, .label = option});
4726 }
4727 select.options = std::move(options);
4728 select.selected = slotProp<std::optional<Key>>([this, point]() -> std::optional<Key> {
4729 Value const& chosen = prefs.get().at(point);
4730 return chosen.isNull() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<Key>{keyOf(chosen)};
4731 });
4732 select.onSelect = [choose](Key const& key) { choose(valueOfKey(key)); };
4733 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, select.common);
4734 return ui::select(std::move(select));
4735 }
4736 if (spec.kind == "value" && (spec.type.kind == TypeKind::String || spec.type.isAny())) {
4737 TextInput input;
4738 input.value =
4739 slotProp<std::string>([this, point] { return textOf(prefs.get().at(point), session.formatting()); });
4740 input.onChange = [choose](std::string text) { choose(Value{std::move(text)}); };
4741 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, input.common);
4742 return ui::textInput(std::move(input));
4743 }
4744 Text placeholder{.text = point, .role = TextRole::Muted};
4745 commonOf(node, ctx, nullptr, placeholder.common);
4746 return ui::text(std::move(placeholder));
4747}

4751
4752inline BorrowedModel Screen::lend(std::string_view alias) const {
4753 detail::NameRef const* const found = _scope->find(alias);
4754 if (found == nullptr || found->category != detail::NameCategory::Model) {
4755 return {};
4756 }
4757 detail::ModelAlias& model = *found->model;
4758 return BorrowedModel{.channel = detail::channelOf(model, *_core),
4759 .token = _core->runtime().untracked([&] { return model.token->get(); })};
4760}
4761
4762inline std::expected<std::unique_ptr<Screen>, Refusal> Interpreter::mount(std::shared_ptr<Document const> doc,
4763 ValueRecord const& params,
4764 IViewBackend& backend,
4765 MountOptions const& options) {
4766 auto refuse = [&](std::string path, std::string reason) {
4767 return std::unexpected(Refusal{.document = doc->id, .path = std::move(path), .reason = std::move(reason)});
4768 };
4769 if (!doc->view) {
4770 return refuse("", "the document has no view");
4771 }
4772 ValueRecord given;
4773 for (auto const& [name, type] : doc->params) {
4774 auto const found = params.find(name);
4775 Value value = found == params.end() ? Value{} : found->second;
4776 if (!type.admits(value)) {
4777 return refuse(pointerAppend("/params", name), value.isNull()
4778 ? "param `" + name + "` is missing"
4779 : "param `" + name + "` is not a " + type.name());
4780 }
4781 given.insert_or_assign(name, std::move(value));
4782 }
4783 for (ModelDecl const& model : doc->scope.models) {
4784 if (model.instance == InstanceMode::Borrowed && !options.borrowed.contains(model.name)) {
4785 return refuse(model.path, "alias `" + model.name + "` borrows a model its opener did not lend");
4786 }
4787 }
4788 reactive::Runtime& runtime = _session->runtime();
4789 std::unique_ptr<Screen> screen{new Screen{}};
4790 screen->_core = std::make_unique<detail::ScreenCore>(doc, *_session, *_dispatcher, _options, options);
4791 detail::ScreenCore& core = *screen->_core;
4792 screen->_scope = std::make_shared<detail::RtScope>(core, nullptr, nullptr, options.depth);
4793 detail::RtScope& scope = *screen->_scope;
4794 scope.submitted = &core.submitted;
4795 scope.showErrors = doc->showErrors;
4796 for (auto const& [name, value] : given) {
4797 detail::NameRef ref;
4798 ref.category = detail::NameCategory::Param;
4799 ref.param = value;
4800 scope.names.insert_or_assign(name, std::move(ref));
4801 }
4802 std::vector<Commands const*> lists;
4803 for (auto const& [key, commands] : doc->lifecycle) {
4804 static_cast<void>(key);
4805 lists.push_back(&commands);
4806 }
4807 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : doc->keys) {
4808 static_cast<void>(chord);
4809 lists.push_back(&commands);
4810 }
4811 Node root = runtime.untracked([&] {
4812 core.declare(scope, &doc->scope, {doc->view.get()}, lists);
4813 detail::LowerCtx const ctx{
4814 .scope = screen->_scope, .bindings = std::make_shared<detail::Bindings const>(), .boundary = nullptr};
4815 Node lowered = core.lower(*doc->view, ctx);
4816 if (!doc->keys.empty()) {
4817 std::vector<KeyBinding> keys;
4818 for (auto const& [chord, commands] : doc->keys) {
4819 keys.push_back(KeyBinding{
4820 .chord = chord, .onPress = [&core, ctx, list = &commands] { core.runEvent(list, ctx, Value{}); }});
4821 }
4822 Column column{.children = {std::move(lowered)}};
4823 column.common.keys = std::move(keys);
4824 lowered = ui::column(std::move(column));
4825 }
4826 return lowered;
4827 });
4828 screen->_mounted.emplace(runtime, backend, std::move(root), options.parent, options.depth + 1);
4829 screen->runLifecycle("onMount");
4830 return screen;
4831}
